Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceNova.name: Ice Nova
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceNova.description: Conjure a wave of ice in all directions, Knocking Back enemies based on how close they are to you. Casting Ice Nova targeting near a Frostbolt Projectile will cause it to originate from the Frostbolt instead of you. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to leave a patch of Chilled Ground.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLeapSlam.name: Leap Slam
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLeapSlam.description:
Jump into the air, damaging and Knocking Back enemies with your mace where you land. Enemies you would land on are
pushed out of the way.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMoltenCrash.name: Molten Crash
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMoltenCrash.description: Shapeshift into a burning monstrosity and leap through the air to crash down upon the earth, Slamming twice and creating Molten Fissures. Consumes Rage to create additional Molten Fissures.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMoltenCrash.tags: Shapeshift, Bear, AoE, Melee, Slam, Travel

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShieldCharge.name: Shield Charge
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShieldCharge.description: Channel to charge in the target direction. You will crash into enemies on your path, stopping your charge and dealing damage to enemies in an area, and extra damage to the enemies you collided with. While charging, your Shield is raised and you will Block all incoming Blockable hits.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDetonateDead.name: Detonate Dead
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDetonateDead.description: Cause a Corpse to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolatileDead.name: Volatile Dead
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolatileDead.description: Consume a Corpse to create a volatile core that seeks out enemies and Ignites enemies near it. The core explodes at the end of its duration.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAddedFireDam.name: Fire Attunement
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAddedFireDam.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Fire Damage but deal less Cold and Lightning Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRapidAttacks.name: Rapid Attacks I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRapidAttacks.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRapidAttacks.name: Rapid Attacks II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRapidAttacks.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRapidAttacks.name: Rapid Attacks III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRapidAttacks.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Attack faster at the cost of Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMultishotSup.name: Multishot I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMultishotSup.description: Supports Projectile skills, making them fire extra Projectiles. Also lowers Attack and Cast speed of supported skills, as well as lessening their damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMultishotSup.name: Multishot II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMultishotSup.description: Supports Projectile skills, making them fire extra Projectiles. Also lowers Attack and Cast speed of supported skills, as well as lessening their damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemNovaProjecti.name: Nova Projectiles I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemNovaProjecti.description: Supports Projectile Skills, making them fire Projectiles in a circle. Does not Support Skills which rain down Projectiles from above.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemProjectileAc.name: Projectile Acceleration I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemProjectileAc.description: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemProjectileAc.name: Projectile Acceleration II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemProjectileAc.description: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster, and granting them a chance to Pierce Enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemProjectileAc.name: Projectile Acceleration III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemProjectileAc.description: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel faster, and causing increases and reductions to Projectile speed to also apply to Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAddedColdDam.name: Cold Attunement
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAddedColdDam.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Cold Damage but deal less Fire and Lightning Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeightenedAc.name: Heightened Accuracy I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeightenedAc.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to gain Accuracy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeightenedAc.name: Heightened Accuracy II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeightenedAc.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to gain Accuracy, and never miss against Enemies on full Life.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMagnifiedAre.name: Magnified Area I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMagnifiedAre.description: Supports any skill with an area of effect, making it larger.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMagnifiedAre.name: Magnified Area II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMagnifiedAre.description: Supports any skill with an area of effect, making it larger.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAddedLightni.name: Lightning Attunement
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAddedLightni.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Lightning Damage but deal less Cold and Fire Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRaiseZombie.name: Raise Zombie
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRaiseZombie.description: Consume a Corpse or Power Charge to create a short-lived Zombie. Zombies created from Power Charges are Empowered and also create two additional non-empowered Zombies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEfficiencySu.name: Efficiency I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEfficiencySu.description: Supports any skill, making it cost less to use. Cannot support skills which reserve Spirit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEfficiencySu.name: Efficiency II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEfficiencySu.description: Supports any skill, making it cost less to use. Cannot support skills which reserve Spirit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIncreasedCri.name: Supercritical
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIncreasedCri.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage with Critical Hits but have less Critical Hit chance.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemKnockbackSup.name: Knockback
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemKnockbackSup.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to Knock Back enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLifeLeechSup.name: Life Leech I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLifeLeechSup.description: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLifeLeechSup.name: Life Leech II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLifeLeechSup.description: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLifeLeechSup.name: Life Leech III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLifeLeechSup.description: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Life and preventing Leech gained this way from being removed at full Life.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemManaLeechSup.name: Mana Leech
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemManaLeechSup.description: Supports Attacks, causing their Physical damage to Leech Mana.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOisinsOathSu.name: Oisin's Oath
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOisinsOathSu.description: Supports Skills which Hit enemies, causing their Mana Leech to recover based on Elemental damage instead of Physical damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAddedChaosDa.name: Chaos Attunement
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAddedChaosDa.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, causing them to Gain Chaos Damage but deal less Damage of other Types.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlickerStrik.name: Flicker Strike
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlickerStrik.description: Teleport to an enemy and Strike them. Consumes Power Charges to perform additional teleporting Strikes on nearby enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpark.name: Spark
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpark.description: Launch a spray of sparking Projectiles that travel erratically along the ground until they hit an enemy or expire. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to fire many sparks in a circle.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPierceSuppor.name: Pierce I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPierceSuppor.description: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an enemy but deal less damage after doing so.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPierceSuppor.name: Pierce II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPierceSuppor.description: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an enemy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPierceSuppor.name: Pierce III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPierceSuppor.description: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Pierce an unlimited number of enemies, losing damage as they do so.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSummonSpectr.name: Spectre: {0}
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSummonSpectr.description: Summon the spirit of the bound monster as a Reviving Minion.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostWall.name: Frost Wall
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostWall.description: Create a wall of Ice Crystals which holds back enemies. The Crystals explode if sufficiently damaged, or if pushed hard enough, damaging nearby enemies. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to add another Lightning explosion if destroyed.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEnervatingNo.name: Enervating Nova
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEnervatingNo.description: Unleash a Nova of Lightning damage to Electrocute enemies. Enemies close to you take no damage while enemies at the edge of the ring take significantly more damage. Enemies Hit can be Electrocuted by all Lightning damage for a short duration.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMeleePhysica.name: Heavy Swing
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMeleePhysica.description: Supports Melee Attacks, boosting their Physical damage at the cost of Attack Speed.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRapidCasting.name: Rapid Casting I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRapidCasting.description: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRapidCasting.name: Rapid Casting II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRapidCasting.description: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRapidCasting.name: Rapid Casting III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRapidCasting.description: Supports Spells, causing them to cast faster for each different Spell you've cast in the last eight seconds.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTemporalChai.name: Temporal Chains
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTemporalChai.description: Curse all enemies in an area, Slowing them and making other effects on them expire more slowly.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEnfeeble.name: Enfeeble
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEnfeeble.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, making them deal less damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSnipersMark.name: Sniper's Mark
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSnipersMark.description: Mark a target. The next Critical Hit the target receives Activates the Mark, Consuming it to deal extra damage and grant you a Frenzy Charge.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDespair.name: Despair
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDespair.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Chaos Resistance.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningWar.name: Lightning Warp
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningWar.description: Target an enemy to either teleport inside the target's body if they are under the Cull threshold, causing it to violently explode, or to apply a Debuff to them, which will cause the same effect if that enemy falls under the Cull threshold during its duration. Can also be used on Ball Lightning Projectiles. On teleport, the target is destroyed, and the explosion deals Lightning damage to surrounding enemies. If targeting an enemy, the explosion also creates Shocked Ground. Creates a Lightning Infusion on successful use. Highlights enemies that can be Culled.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVileDisrupti.name: His Vile Intrusion
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVileDisrupti.description: Target an enemy to either teleport inside the target's body if they are under the Cull threshold, causing it to violently explode, or to apply a Debuff to them, which will cause the same effect if that enemy falls under the Cull threshold during its duration. On teleport, the target is destroyed, and the explosion deals Physical damage to surrounding enemies and inflicts Impale.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArmourBreake.name: Armour Breaker
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArmourBreake.description: Strike with a forceful blow, knocking enemies back and weakening their Armour.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRainOfArrows.name: Rain of Arrows
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRainOfArrows.description: Fire a hail of arrows into the air, causing them to rain from above. Consumes a Frenzy Charge to fire more arrows.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemConcentrated.name: Concentrated Area
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemConcentrated.description: Supports any skill with an area of effect, causing that area to be smaller but any area damage it deals to be higher.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBloodlustSup.name: Bloodlust
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBloodlustSup.description: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to deal more damage against Bleeding enemies, but preventing them from inflicting Bleeding.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFirestorm.name: Firestorm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFirestorm.description: Rain a storm of flaming bolts over the targeted area. Can Consume all three types of Elemental Infusion, creating a much larger storm when Fire-Infused, causing lightning bolts when Lightning-Infused, and raining ice bolts when Cold-Infused.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFirestorm.tags: AoE, Sustained, Fire, Duration, Repeatable, Storm

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFallingThund.name: Falling Thunder
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFallingThund.description: Suffuse your Quarterstaff with electrical energy, then Slam the ground to deal damage in a large cone in front of you. Consumes your Power Charges to fire Lightning Projectiles forwards from the impact.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPowerSiphon.name: Power Siphon
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPowerSiphon.description: Attempt to rip the lifeforce from an enemy. Enemies within Culling range will be highlighted and instantly killed on Hit, granting a Power Charge. Can only target Enemies in Culling range.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningArr.name: Lightning Arrow
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningArr.description: Fire a charged arrow at the target. On hitting an enemy or wall, the arrow will fire Chaining Lightning beams at nearby enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDiscipline.name: Discipline
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDiscipline.description: Emit an Aura that grants you and Allies in your Presence additional Total Energy Shield.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockwaveTot.name: Shockwave Totem
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockwaveTot.description: Raise a Totem that Slams the ground around it, repeatedly damaging nearby enemies. Jagged Ground erupts when hit by this Slam, damaging enemies standing on it. The Totem cannot create Jagged Ground. This Skill can be used while Shapeshifted.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockwaveTot.tags: Totem, AoE, Melee, Slam, Duration, Nova

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBlindSupport.name: Blind I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBlindSupport.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to Blind on Hit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBlindSupport.name: Blind II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBlindSupport.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to Blind on Hit with increased effect.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemValakosCharg.name: Valako's Charge
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemValakosCharg.description: While active, taking Lightning damage builds up charge on you. Reaching full charge expends all charge to Trigger this skill, creating a Chaining lightning bolt that arcs to nearby enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArc.name: Arc
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArc.description: An arc of Lightning stretches from the caster to a targeted enemy and Chains on to other nearby enemies. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to deal more damage and Chain further.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArcticArmour.name: Arctic Armour
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArcticArmour.description: While active, conjures an icy barrier that gains stages over time. While the barrier has stages, Melee Attacks that hit you will remove a stage to cause a burst of ice that deals Cold Spell damage to the attacker.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFirePenetrat.name: Fire Penetration I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFirePenetrat.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Fire resistance.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFirePenetrat.name: Fire Penetration II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFirePenetrat.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits ignore enemy Fire resistance.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemColdPenetrat.name: Cold Penetration
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemColdPenetrat.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Cold resistance.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningPen.name: Lightning Penetration
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningPen.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Lightning resistance.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChainSupport.name: Chain I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChainSupport.description: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChainSupport.name: Chain II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChainSupport.description: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChainSupport.name: Chain III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChainSupport.description: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain additional times.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemForkSupport.name: Fork
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemForkSupport.description: Supports Projectile skills, making their Projectiles Fork.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemElementalWea.name: Elemental Weakness
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemElementalWea.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, lowering their Elemental Resistances.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemElementalWea.tags: AoE, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Duration, Curse, Repeatable

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIncinerate.name: Incinerate
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIncinerate.description: Gain fuel by spending Mana on any Skill, then use the accumulated fuel to conjure a torrent of Fire from your hand, Igniting enemies in front of you. The flames grow stronger the longer you Channel. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to also create Ignited Ground. Cannot gain fuel while using this skill.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpellEchoSup.name: Spell Echo
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpellEchoSup.description: Supports Cascadable Spells you use yourself. Supported Spells Echo.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemElementalArm.name: Elemental Army
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemElementalArm.description: Supports skills which create Minions, bolstering the Elemental Resistances of those Minions. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemProjectileDe.name: Projectile Deceleration I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemProjectileDe.description: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel more slowly.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemProjectileDe.name: Projectile Deceleration II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemProjectileDe.description: Supports Projectile skills, making those Projectiles travel more slowly.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVilentasProp.name: Vilenta's Propulsion
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVilentasProp.description: Supports Spell Skills that fire Projectiles, causing increases and reductions to cast speed to also apply to Projectile speed.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPurityOfFire.name: Purity of Fire
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPurityOfFire.description: Emit an Aura that boosts the Fire Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPurityOfIce.name: Purity of Ice
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPurityOfIce.description: Emit an Aura that boosts the Cold Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPurityOfLigh.name: Purity of Lightning
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPurityOfLigh.description: Emit an Aura that boosts the Lightning Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemImpurity.name: Impurity
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemImpurity.description: Emit an Aura that boosts the Chaos Resistance of you and Allies in your Presence.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlameblast.name: Flameblast
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlameblast.description: Channel to build destructive energy around you. Releasing the energy causes a devastating explosion that is larger and more intense the longer you Channel for.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBarrage.name: Barrage
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBarrage.description: Ready a volley of arrows or spears, Empowering your next Repeatable Bow or Projectile Spear Attack to Repeat multiple times. Consumes your Frenzy Charges on use to add additional repeats.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBallLightnin.name: Ball Lightning
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBallLightnin.description: Fire a slow-moving Projectile that moves through enemies. The Projectile itself does not Hit enemies, but repeatedly discharges bolts of Lightning at nearby enemies. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to slow down over time, create Ignited Ground as it travels, and explode dealing Fire damage in an Area after it dissipates.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBallLightnin.tags: AoE, Projectile, Sustained, Lightning, Duration, Chaining, Repeatable

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBoneOffering.name: Bone Offering
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBoneOffering.description: Impale a Skeleton on a bone spike to shield your Minions while the spike remains, reducing the amount of damage taken from Hits. Taking a Hit that deals damage above a certain threshold will cause that Minion's shield to absorb all damage from that Hit, then explode.  The bone spike is itself a Minion, and shields itself. If it dies, shields on your other Minions disappear.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfAsh.name: Herald of Ash
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfAsh.description: While active, enemies you sufficiently Overkill with non-Herald Attacks will cause an explosion that Ignites nearby enemies based on the Overkill damage dealt.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfIce.name: Herald of Ice
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfIce.description: While active, Shattering an enemy with a non-Herald Attack Hit will cause an icy explosion that deals Attack damage to surrounding enemies.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfIce.tags: Attack, Persistent, AoE, Cold, Herald, Payoff

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfThun.name: Herald of Thunder
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfThun.description: While active, killing Shocked enemies with a non-Herald Attack Hit will cause subsequent Attack Hits to release lightning bolts which dealAttack damage to all surrounding enemies.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfThun.tags: Attack, Persistent, AoE, Lightning, Herald, Payoff

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBlasphemy.name: Blasphemy
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBlasphemy.description: Turn socketed Curse skills into vile Auras, applying their effects to all nearby enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemInfernallCry.name: Infernal Cry
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemInfernallCry.description: Perform a Warcry, Empowering subsequent Melee Attacks if there are enemies nearby. Enemies in the warcry's area are destabilised and will Combust on death. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceBiteSuppo.name: Ice Bite I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceBiteSuppo.description: Supports damaging skills and Warcries you use yourself. Freezing an enemy with supported skills infuses your damage with Cold damage for a short time.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceBiteSuppo.name: Ice Bite II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceBiteSuppo.description: Supports damaging skills and Warcries you use yourself. Freezing an enemy with supported skills infuses your damage with Cold damage for a short time.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBhatairsVeng.name: Bhatair's Vengeance
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBhatairsVeng.description: Supports Attacks and Warcries you use yourself. Freezing an enemy with Supported Skills infuses you and your allies with Cold damage for a short time.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFreezeSuppor.name: Freeze
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFreezeSuppor.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more effective at Freezing enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockSupport.name: Shock
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockSupport.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Shock.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShatteringSp.name: Shattering Spite
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShatteringSp.description: Stamp your spear, destroying all Bloodstone Lances on each enemy in your Presence to cause a damaging explosion around that enemy. Each explosion gains new benefits when reaching higher thresholds of Bloodstone Lances removed from an enemy, causing them to deal more damage, have increased area of effect, and Leech Life from enemies caught in the blast.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRighteousDes.name: Righteous Descent
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRighteousDes.description: Leap into the air carried by divine wings, damaging enemies with your spear where you land. If there is a Fragment of Divinity near you or the targeted location, this attack will Consume it when you leap to become Empowered, dealing more damage and granting life and mana recovery. This skill does not use up its Cooldown when empowered.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRighteousDes.tags: AoE, Melee, Slam, Physical, Lightning, Travel

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRollingMagma.name: Rolling Magma
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRollingMagma.description: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and lob a ball of magma that deals area damage as it hits the ground. The skillChains, bouncing forward to deal damage multiple times. Impacts on Molten Fissures or Volcanos will activate them as though they were Slammed.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRollingMagma.tags: Shapeshift, Wyvern, AoE, Projectile, Fire, Detonator

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostBomb.name: Frost Bomb
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostBomb.description: Create a pulsing Orb of frost. Each pulse inflicts Elemental Exposure on nearby enemies. When the Orb's duration ends, it Detonates, dealing Cold damage to surrounding enemies and leaving behind a Cold Infusion.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOrbOfStorms.name: Orb of Storms
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOrbOfStorms.description: Create an Orb of electricity that fires Chaining Lightning bolts at nearby enemies. The Orb leaves behind a Lightning Infusion Remnant when it expires.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOrbOfStorms.tags: AoE, Sustained, Lightning, Duration, Chaining, Orb, Remnant, Repeatable

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEarthquake.name: Earthquake
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEarthquake.description: Smash the ground, dealing damage in an area and leaving behind Jagged Ground that slows enemies. The Jagged Ground erupts in a powerful Aftershock after a duration. Cannot create Jagged Ground on top of an existing patch, or if you already have the maximum number of active patches.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemContagion.name: Contagion
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemContagion.description: Afflict a single enemy with a Debuff that deals Chaos damage over time. If the enemy dies while affected by Contagion, it spreads itself, Curses, and other Chaos damage over time Debuffs on the target to nearby enemies. This refreshes their durations. Reanimating or detonating a corpse affected by Contagion will cause the Minion or explosion to spread Contagion on hit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWither.name: Wither
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWither.description: Channel a debilitating hex that Withers enemies in the area.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEssenceDrain.name: Essence Drain
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEssenceDrain.description: Fire a Projectile that applies a powerful Chaos damage over time debuff to enemies it hits.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemControlledDe.name: Controlled Destruction
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemControlledDe.description: Supports Spells that Hit enemies, boosting their damage but preventing them from dealing Critical Hits.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSunder.name: Sunder
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSunder.description: Slam the ground, creating a roiling fissure that damages enemies in a sequence of areas in front of you. A number of enemies hit by the wave will release a shockwave, damaging other enemies. Hitting an enemy with Fully Broken Armour applies Sundered Armour, making it take additional increased Physical damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostBolt.name: Frostbolt
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostBolt.description: Fire a slow-moving Piercing Projectile that is effective at Chilling enemies and explodes on colliding with terrain.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemElementalFoc.name: Elemental Focus
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemElementalFoc.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more Elemental Damage but be unable to inflict Elemental Ailments.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalSnip.name: Skeletal Sniper
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalSnip.description: Activate to summon long-ranged, Reviving Skeletal Snipers that can fire a gas arrow on Command.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalReav.name: Skeletal Reaver
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalReav.description: Activate to summon aggressive, Reviving Skeletal Reavers that can enrage on Command. Skeletal Reavers do more Attack Damage and gain increased Attack speed based on their Rage

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalBrut.name: Skeletal Brute
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalBrut.description: Activate to summon hard-hitting, Reviving Skeletal Brutes that can Stun Primed enemies and Warcry on Command. This Warcry Intimidates nearby enemies and Consumes Freeze on enemies and allies to deal damage in an Area around them.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalFros.name: Skeletal Frost Mage
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalFros.description: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Frost Mages that can envelop your Minions in an icy shield on Command.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalStor.name: Skeletal Storm Mage
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalStor.description: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Storm Mages that can call down a lightning strike on dead Skeletons on Command.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalArso.name: Skeletal Arsonist
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalArso.description: Activate to summon bomb-throwing, Reviving Skeletal Arsonists that can detonate other Minions on Command.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalCler.name: Skeletal Cleric
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkeletalCler.description: Activate to summon Reviving Skeletal Clerics that heal other minions and revive fallen Skeletons.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAzmerianWolf.name: Azmerian Wolf
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAzmerianWolf.description: Summons an ancient Reviving Azmerian Wolf that can howl, calling to spirits convening an Eternal Hunt on Command. It Maims when attacking foes, and can lunge to bite and inflict Bleeding, or howl to inspire nearby allies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMistRaven.name: Mist Raven
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMistRaven.description: Summons a mysterious undamageable Mist Raven that can be Commanded to dive at target location, crashing through an otherworldly mirror and damaging enemies in an area. The raven grants you a Frenzy Charge for each enemy it Culls.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpiralingCon.name: Spiraling Conspiracy
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpiralingCon.description: A flock of mist ravens circle you, dealing damage over time in an area. Their numbers are bolstered by slain foes, or in the Presence of dangerous enemies, but the flock as a whole is considered a single minion. You can Command some of them to take flight, leaving the flock to assail your enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWildfireSupp.name: Wildfire
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWildfireSupp.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, Spreading Ignites it inflicts to nearby enemies after a delay.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBleedSupport.name: Bleed I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBleedSupport.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to inflict Bleeding.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBleedSupport.name: Bleed II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBleedSupport.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to inflict Bleeding.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBleedSupport.name: Bleed III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBleedSupport.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to inflict Bleeding.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBleedSupport.name: Bleed IV
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBleedSupport.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more Melee Physical Damage to Bleeding Enemies, but be unable to inflict Bleeding itself. Supported Skills also inflict Incision on Hit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPoisonSuppor.name: Poison I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPoisonSuppor.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Poison enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPoisonSuppor.name: Poison II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPoisonSuppor.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Poison enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPoisonSuppor.name: Poison III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPoisonSuppor.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Poison enemies and causing it to inflict more powerful Poisons against Bleeding Enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMaimSupport.name: Maim
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMaimSupport.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Maim enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemImmolateSupp.name: Immolate
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemImmolateSupp.description: Supports Attacks, granting them extra Fire damage against Ignited enemies but making them unable to Ignite enemies themselves.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLastingShock.name: Lasting Shock
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLastingShock.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies or inflicts Shock, causing its Shocks to be inflicted less often but last longer.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBrutalitySup.name: Brutality I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBrutalitySup.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBrutalitySup.name: Brutality II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBrutalitySup.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBrutalitySup.name: Brutality III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBrutalitySup.description: Supports any skill that deals damage, boosting its Physical damage at the expense of all other Damage Types, as well as giving Hits from that skill a chance to ignore Physical Damage reduction.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMomentumSupp.name: Momentum
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMomentumSupp.description: Supports any damaging skill that you use yourself, causing it to deal more damage if you move a sufficient distance while using the skill. Teleportation does not count towards the distance travelled.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArcaneSurgeS.name: Arcane Surge
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArcaneSurgeS.description: Supports Spells you cast yourself, tracking the mana you spend to cast them. Spending enough mana grants a burst of Mana Regeneration and Cast Speed.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVulnerabilit.name: Vulnerability
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVulnerabilit.description: Curse all targets in an area after a short delay, making Hits against them ignore a portion of their Armour.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWitheringTou.name: Withering Touch
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWitheringTou.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to Wither enemies on Hit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSoulrend.name: Soulrend
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSoulrend.description: Fire a Piercing Projectile that seeks out enemies. Enemies hit are inflicted with a Debuff that Hinders them and deals Chaos damage over time for a short duration.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExpandSuppor.name: Expand
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExpandSuppor.description: Supports Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them over time. The Seals are broken when cast, increasing area of effect. Cannot support Channelling Skills or Skills with a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUnleashSuppo.name: Unleash
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUnleashSuppo.description: Supports Repeatable Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them over time. The Seals are broken when cast, each causing the Spell to Repeat. Cannot support skills with a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemZarokhsRevol.name: Zarokh's Revolt
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemZarokhsRevol.description: Supports Repeatable Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them over time and giving them a moderate Cooldown. The Seals are broken when cast, each causing the Spell to Repeat. Cannot support skills which already have a Cooldown or gain seals.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCloseCombatS.name: Close Combat I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCloseCombatS.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage to enemies based on how close they are to you.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCloseCombatS.name: Close Combat II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCloseCombatS.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to deal more damage to enemies based on how close they are to you.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRageSupport.name: Rage I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRageSupport.description: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRageSupportT.name: Rage II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRageSupportT.description: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRageSupportT.name: Rage III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRageSupportT.description: Supports Melee Attacks, causing them to grant Rage on Hit. Supported Skills have signficantly higher Attack speed while you or supported minion are not at maximum Rage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPlagueBearer.name: Plague Bearer
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPlagueBearer.description: While active, stores a portion of the Poison Damage you deal. Using this Skill unleashes the stored Poison to damage and Poison enemies around you.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFeedingFrenz.name: Feeding Frenzy I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFeedingFrenz.description: Supports skills which create Minions, making them deal and take more damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMeatShieldSu.name: Meat Shield I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMeatShieldSu.description: Supports skills which create Minions, granting them less damage taken but making them deal less damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMeatShieldSu.name: Meat Shield II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMeatShieldSu.description: Supports skills which create Minions, granting them less damage taken but making them deal less damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBrutusBrainS.name: Brutus' Brain
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBrutusBrainS.description: Supports skills which create Minions, causing those Minions to be unable to deal or take Damage. Cannot support skills which create undamageable Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemInfernalLegi.name: Infernal Legion I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemInfernalLegi.description: Supports skills which create Minions which can be damaged, causing them and enemies near them to Ignite. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemInfernalLegi.name: Infernal Legion II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemInfernalLegi.description: Supports skills which create Minions which can be damaged, causing them and enemies near them to Ignite. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemInfernalLegi.name: Infernal Legion III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemInfernalLegi.description: Supports skills which create Minions which can be damaged, causing them and enemies near them to Ignite. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSiegeBallist.name: Siege Ballista
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSiegeBallist.description: Deploy a Ballista Totem that fires bolts skyward, to explode a short time after landing.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSiegeBallist.tags: Totem, AoE, Projectile, Sustained, Fire, Duration, Repeatable

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSecondWindSu.name: Second Wind I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSecondWindSu.description: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSecondWindSu.name: Second Wind II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSecondWindSu.description: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSecondWindSu.name: Second Wind III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSecondWindSu.description: Supports Skills which have a cooldown, giving them extra uses of that cooldown and causing them to recover your Life when a Skill is used and goes on cooldown. Cannot support Meta, instant, or Triggered Skills, and cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSeismicCry.name: Seismic Cry
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSeismicCry.description: Perform a damaging Warcry, Knocking Back nearby enemies and Heavy Stunning enemies that are Primed for Stun. If an enemy is Heavy Stunned or a currently Heavy Stunned enemy is Hit, this Skill Empowers subsequent Slams to perform an additional Aftershock. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEarthshatter.name: Earthshatter
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEarthshatter.description: Slam the ground, sending out a fissure that deals area damage to enemies it passes under and thrusts a spike from the ground when it ends. Warcries performed near the spike will cause it to shatter, damaging surrounding enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSigilOfPower.name: Sigil of Power
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSigilOfPower.description: Place a Sigil on the ground, providing a powerful Spell Damage Buff to you and Allies while standing in it. The Buff becomes more powerful the more mana you spend while standing in the Sigil.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSigilOfLife.name: Rite of Restoration
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSigilOfLife.description: Place a Sigil on the ground, providing a powerful Buff to you and Allies standing in it which grants Life Regeneration and amplifies Armour, Evasion and Energy Shield. The Buff becomes more powerful the more mana you spend while standing in the Sigil.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlameWall.name: Flame Wall
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlameWall.description: Create a wall of Fire in front of you, which Ignites everything within its area. Any Projectiles fired through the wall by you and Allies deal added Fire damage. Consumes a Lightning Infusion if possible to also add Lightning damage to the Projectiles.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemImpendingDoo.name: Impending Doom
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemImpendingDoo.description: Supports Curse skills you cast yourself, causing them to trigger Doom Blast on Cursed enemies when the Curse expires.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHexblast.name: Hexblast
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHexblast.description: Detonate a Curse on every enemy in an area, causing explosions of Chaos damage but removing the Curse. Can only detonate Curses for which at least half of the duration has expired.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExsanguinate.name: Exsanguinate
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExsanguinate.description: Expel your own blood as Chaining blood tendrils in a cone in front of you. Enemies Hit by the tendrils take Physical damage and are inflicted with Bleeding.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemReap.name: Reap
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemReap.description: Conjure a bloody scythe that sweeps across the targeted area, dealing Physical damage to enemies and applying Critical Weakness. Cannot be Triggered.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBloodMagicSu.name: Lifetap
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBloodMagicSu.description: Supports any Skill, turning its Mana cost into a Life cost. Does not support Skills which reserve Spirit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAtaluiBloodl.name: Atalui's Bloodletting
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAtaluiBloodl.description: Supports any Skill, turning a portion of its Mana cost into a Life cost. Does not support Skills which reserve Spirit. Supported Skills Gain a portion of their Life cost as extra Physical Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBeheadSuppor.name: Behead I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBeheadSuppor.description: Supports Strike skills, causing them to steal a Modifier from Rare monsters they kill.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBeheadSuppor.name: Behead II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBeheadSuppor.description: Supports Strike skills, causing them to steal two Modifiers from Rare monsters they kill.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEinharsBeast.name: Einhar's Beastrite
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEinharsBeast.description: Supports Melee Strike skills, causing them to steal a Modifier from Rare monsters they kill for a lengthy duration, while being unable to damage enemies not on low Life. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExecuteSuppo.name: Execute I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExecuteSuppo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExecuteSuppo.name: Execute II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExecuteSuppo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExecuteSuppo.name: Execute III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExecuteSuppo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to deal more damage against enemies on Low Life, as well as dealing more damage while you are on Low Life.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBoneshatter.name: Boneshatter
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBoneshatter.description: Attack enemies with a melee Strike. The Strike will cause a Heavy Stun on enemies that are Primed for Stun. Upon causing a Heavy Stun it will also create a Shockwave, dealing a large amount of damage in an area.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEyeOfWinter.name: Eye of Winter
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEyeOfWinter.description: Fire a single Eye Projectile which does not Hit enemies. The Eye constantly releases damaging shard Projectiles in a spiral as it flies. If the Eye passes over an Elemental Ground Surface or Orb, it will take on that surface's effect causing shards to deal more damage of the corresponding Type.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTornado.name: Tornado
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTornado.description: Create a storm that sucks in enemies and deals Physical damage over time. A Tornado that overlaps an Elemental Ground Surface absorbs that surface's Debuff, applying it to enemies inside the Tornado and causing the Tornado to deal extra damage of that element.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOverchargeSu.name: Overcharge
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOverchargeSu.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making its Shocks more effective but reflecting them back to you as well.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningCon.name: Lightning Conduit
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningCon.description: Call down Lightning to hit all enemies in a cone in front of you, dealing significantly more damage to Shocked enemies. If there is a Shocked enemy in the target area, additional lightning bolts are distributed among the targets hit. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGalvanicFiel.name: Galvanic Field
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGalvanicFiel.description: Gain a Buff that boosts your Shock chance. Shocking an enemy consumes the Buff to attach an Orb of electricity to that enemy. The Orb fires bolts of electricity at nearby enemies until it expires.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGalvanicFiel.tags: Spell, AoE, Sustained, Lightning, Duration, Chaining, Orb

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolcanicFiss.name: Volcanic Fissure
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolcanicFiss.description: Slam the ground, creating a branching Molten Fissure that deals damage as it travels and remains for a duration. Using a different Slam on a Molten Fissure creates a spreading Aftershock.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolcanicFiss.tags: AoE, Melee, Slam, Sustained, Fire, Duration

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRapidAssault.name: Rapid Assault
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRapidAssault.description: Perform a series of six rapid stabs. The final stab inflicts Bleeding and leaves a spearhead stuck in the target, Maiming them for a duration. Detonator Skills will cause the stuck spearheads to explode, dealing further damage to the target and other nearby enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDisengage.name: Disengage
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDisengage.description: Jump back as you rupture the earth in front of you with spearpoints, damaging enemies. Consumes the Parried Debuff on Hitting enemies to release a shockwave and grant you a Frenzy Charge. This skill can be used while using other skills, and causes Strikes and Projectiles to miss you while jumping. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBloodHunt.name: Blood Hunt
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBloodHunt.description: Lunge at a target and skewers them. Hitting an enemy that has suffered Blood Loss will cause a blood explosion and also Consume Bleeding. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWhirlingSlas.name: Whirling Slash
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWhirlingSlas.description: Perform a circular slash that kicks up a Whirlwind around you, Slowing enemies and Blinding them in its area of effect. Leaving the area collapses the storm, dealing damage and causing Knockback.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpearfield.name: Spearfield
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpearfield.description: Stab the ground causing multiple spears to burst out of the ground in front of you in a large area. The spears remain for a duration, or explode when enemies touch them, damaging and Maiming them.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningSpe.name: Lightning Spear
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningSpe.description: Throw a single copy of your spear. When it hits an enemy it bursts, firing secondary lightning bolt Projectiles at multiple other enemies within a large area around it. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to cause the main spear to split into multiple copies on impact, each of which then bursts.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGlacialLance.name: Glacial Lance
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGlacialLance.description: Throw a single Piercing lance that leaves icy fragments in its wake. The fragments Chill nearby enemies. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to cause the glacial fragments created by the first Projectile to explode outwards after a short duration, peppering enemies with shrapnel.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWhirlingAssa.name: Whirling Assault
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWhirlingAssa.description: Advance while hitting enemies around you with a series of spinning Strikes.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRollingSlam.name: Rolling Slam
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRollingSlam.description: Slam the ground to Stun enemies and knock them away, then continue forward and perform a devastating second Slam.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEscapeShot.name: Escape Shot
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEscapeShot.description: Leap backwards, firing an icy arrow which can Chill or Freeze enemies around the location from which you escaped. This arrow will create Ice Fragments on impact.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSupercharged.name: Supercharged Slam
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSupercharged.description: Channel to charge up a heavy swing, drawing earth from the ground to enlarge your mace. Release to Slam the ground, dealing damage in an area around the impact, followed by Aftershocks dealing damage in a larger area. This Skill has its own Attack time, which is not affected by your weapon's attack speed and cannot be modified.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWindBlast.name: Wind Blast
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWindBlast.description: Batter enemies at range by generating a gust of wind as you swing. Enemies will be Dazed and Knocked Back based on how close they are to you.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWaveOfFrost.name: Wave of Frost
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWaveOfFrost.description: Flip backwards and send forth a Freezing wave in front of you, immediately Freezing enemies which are Primed for Freeze.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceStrike.name: Ice Strike
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceStrike.description: Perform a fast icy Strike. Using this Attack three times in quick succession causes a final strike that is slower and more powerful.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemJaggedGround.name: Jagged Ground I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemJaggedGround.description: Supports Slam skills. Supported Skills will consume Endurance Charges on use to create Jagged Ground. Cannot Support Skills which consume Endurance Charges.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemJaggedGround.name: Jagged Ground II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemJaggedGround.description: Supports Slam skills. Aftershocks caused by Supported Slam Skills always create patches of Jagged Ground.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemInevitableCr.name: Inexorable Critical I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemInevitableCr.description: Supports any skill you use yourself that Hits enemies, causing it to accumulate Critical Hit chance over time.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemInevitableCr.name: Inexorable Critical II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemInevitableCr.description: Supports any skill you use yourself that Hits enemies, causing it to accumulate Critical Hit chance over time, but also reduce your Critical Damage Bonus.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRuthlessSupp.name: Ruthless
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRuthlessSupp.description: Supports Attacks, causing repeated uses to be more effective at Stunning enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCompressedDu.name: Compressed Duration I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCompressedDu.description: Supports any skill that has a duration making that duration shorter.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCompressedDu.name: Compressed Duration II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCompressedDu.description: Supports any skill that has a duration making that duration shorter.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFistOfWarSup.name: Fist of War I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFistOfWarSup.description: Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFistOfWarSup.name: Fist of War II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFistOfWarSup.description: Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFistOfWarSup.name: Fist of War III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFistOfWarSup.description: Supports Slams you use yourself, providing a very powerful Ancestral Boost infrequently.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemProlongedDur.name: Prolonged Duration I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemProlongedDur.description: Supports any skill that has a duration, making that duration longer.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemProlongedDur.name: Prolonged Duration II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemProlongedDur.description: Supports any skill that has a duration, making that duration longer.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemImpactShockw.name: Impact Shockwave
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemImpactShockw.description: Supports Melee Strike Skills and Wind Attack Skills, causing them to create an Aftershock that damages enemies around the target when they Heavy Stun an enemy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHexBloomSupp.name: Hex Bloom
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHexBloomSupp.description: Supports Curses, spreading their effects when a Cursed enemy dies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGlacialCasca.name: Glacial Cascade
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGlacialCasca.description: Sweep your Quarterstaff upwards, releasing an icy fissure which deals damage in a series of bursts culminating in a large spike. Frozen enemies hit by the final spike are dealt heavy damage but the Freeze is Consumed. Ice Crystals hit by the final spike explode.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemComet.name: Comet
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemComet.description: Call down a mass of ice from the sky, dealing high damage at the targeted location. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast. Consumes a Fire Infusion if possible to cause a devastating blast of ice and fire.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStaffConsecr.name: Consecrate
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStaffConsecr.description: Create an area of Consecrated Ground around you.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArtilleryBal.name: Artillery Ballista
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArtilleryBal.description: Deploy a Ballista Totem that rains down a salvo of Pinning, Maiming bolts.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemManaTempest.name: Mana Tempest
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemManaTempest.description: Create a storm of arcane energies that Empowers your Mana-costing Spells while you remain inside it. Maintaining the storm constantly drains your Mana, and spending more causes it to drain faster. The storm will dissipate when you exit it or run out of Mana.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemKillingPalm.name: Killing Palm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemKillingPalm.description: Dash to an enemy and Strike them, Culling enemies if their life is low enough and performing additional dashing Strikes to other Cullable targets in range if your target was Culled. Each enemy killed by this strike grants a Power Charge, with higher Rarity monsters granting additional Charges. Enemies around you that can be Culled will be highlighted.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCrushingFear.name: Crushing Fear
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCrushingFear.description: Dash to an enemy and Strike them, Culling enemies if their life is low enough. When this skill kills an enemy you draw out their final fears, crushing them to create a shockwave. Enemies around you that can be Culled will be highlighted.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShatteringPa.name: Shattering Palm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShatteringPa.description: Dash to an enemy and Strike them with an Attack that manifests a wave of cold, coating nearby enemies in shards of ice. Dealing enough damage to these enemies will shatter the shards, causing an icy explosion that deals Attack damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolcano.name: Volcano
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolcano.description: Uplift a volcano from the earth, damaging enemies standing on it and releasing a spray of molten Projectiles. While the volcano persists, Slamming it will cause another Projectile spray. Channelling this Skill for longer makes the initial eruption more violent, but does not affect subsequent Projectile sprays.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolcano.tags: AoE, Projectile, Sustained, Fire, Duration, Channelling

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfPack.name: Wolf Pack
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfPack.description: Activate to summon a pack of Wolf Companions. The pack treated as a single Companion for effects that count or limit Companions, regardless of the number of Wolves in the pack.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHyenaCackle.name: Cackling Companions
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHyenaCackle.description: Activate to summon a cackle of Hyena Companions. The cackle is treated as a single Companion for effects that count or limit Companions, regardless of the number of Hyenas in the cackle. Hyenas whoop when they first appear, Hindering nearby enemies, and have a chance to Maim enemies they Hit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChillingIceS.name: Frost Nexus
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChillingIceS.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to create patches of Chilled Ground around Frozen enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpiralVolley.name: Spiral Volley
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpiralVolley.description: Load your Bow with a volley of enchanted arrows and fire them in a circle as you spin forward, firing directly at targets if possible. Consumes Frenzy Charges to cause the arrows to deal more damage and Chain to other targets. Each target can only be Hit once.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBearMaul.name: Maul
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBearMaul.description: Shapeshift into a Bear and rake enemies with your claws, generating Rage on Hit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWyvernRend.name: Rend
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWyvernRend.description: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and perform a wide slash with your wingtip claws. Consumes a Power Charge if possible to grant you a Buff that gives you extra Lightning damage. While you have the Buff, Rend covers a much larger area but is slower.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWyvernRend.tags: Shapeshift, Wyvern, AoE, Melee, Strike, Duration

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfPounce.name: Pounce
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfPounce.description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and leap to a target location, damaging enemies in an area around where you land. Predator's Mark will be Triggered targeting the highest Rarity enemy Hit, or if a Mark gem is socketed into this Skill, that Mark will be Triggered instead. Using this Skill allows any Wolf Minions you have to leap immediately.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfPounce.tags: Minion, Shapeshift, Werewolf, AoE, Melee, Slam, Trigger, Mark, Duration, Travel, Meta

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningBol.name: Lightning Bolt
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLightningBol.description: Call down a Shocking bolt of Lightning to strike enemies in a small area.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBearRampage.name: Rampage
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBearRampage.description: Shapeshift into a Bear and charge forward, Slamming the ground as you run. Channelling ends after a short amount of time but can be prolonged by spending Rage.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBearRampage.tags: Shapeshift, Bear, AoE, Melee, Slam, Sustained, Channelling, Travel

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEnergyShield.name: Shock Siphon
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEnergyShield.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing you to recover Energy Shield when it kills a Shocked enemy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUnleash.name: Unleash
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUnleash.description: Augment yourself with temporal magic for a short duration, Empowering the next Repeatable Spell you cast to Repeat multiple times. Cannot Empower Skills with a Cooldown.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockConduct.name: Shock Conduction
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockConduct.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to also Shock nearby enemies when you Shock an enemy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockConduct.name: Shock Conduction II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockConduct.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to also Shock nearby enemies when you Shock an enemy. Always Shocks enemies which are Drenched.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLastingFrost.name: Deep Freeze
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLastingFrost.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing Freeze it inflicts to last longer.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemThunderstorm.name: Thunderstorm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemThunderstorm.description: Conjure a thunderstorm which causes lightning strikes and torrential rain in an area. Enemies in the area are Drenched, causing them to become Shocked or Frozen more easily. Plants in the area become Overgrown.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIgniteSuppor.name: Ignite I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIgniteSuppor.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Ignite.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIgniteSuppor.name: Ignite II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIgniteSuppor.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Ignite.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIgniteSuppor.name: Ignite III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIgniteSuppor.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making it more likely to Ignite and causing inflicted Ignites to deal their damage more quickly.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDeadlyIgnite.name: Searing Flame I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDeadlyIgnite.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but its Hits to deal less damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDeadlyIgnite.name: Searing Flame II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDeadlyIgnite.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but its Hits to deal less damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIgniteDurati.name: Eternal Flame I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIgniteDurati.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing its Ignites to be inflicted less often but last longer.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIgniteDurati.name: Eternal Flame II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIgniteDurati.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing its Ignites to last longer.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIgniteDurati.name: Eternal Flame III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIgniteDurati.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to refresh Ignites on Critical Hit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEssenceHarve.name: Essence Harvest
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEssenceHarve.description: Supports Skills which create Reviving Persistent Minions. When those Minions die, you Recoup a percentage of your maximum Mana.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFuriousSlam.name: Furious Slam
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFuriousSlam.description: Shapeshift into a Bear and Slam the ground with great force, causing a pair of shockwaves. Can spend Rage to create larger shockwaves that leave behind Jagged Ground.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFerociousRoa.name: Ferocious Roar
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFerociousRoa.description: Shapeshift into a Bear and roar in defiance, immediately gaining Rage if there are enemies nearby and Empowering subsequent Attacks to Break Armour. Alternatively, socketing a human-form Warcry into this Skill triggers that Warcry instead, and augments its damage and area. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnElemen.name: Cast on Elemental Ailment
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnElemen.description: While active, gains Energy when you Freeze, Shock, or Ignite enemies, and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnElemen.tags: Persistent, Trigger, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Meta

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnMeleeK.name: Cast on Melee Kill
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnMeleeK.description: While active, gains Energy when you kill enemies with Melee Attacks and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnCritic.name: Cast on Critical
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnCritic.description: While active, gains Energy when you Critically Hit enemies and triggers socketed Spells on reaching maximum Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExploitWeakn.name: Exploit Weakness
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExploitWeakn.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more Damage against enemies with Broken Armour but preventing them from Breaking Armour themselves. Cannot support skills that Consume Broken Armour.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBarrierInvoc.name: Barrier Invocation
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBarrierInvoc.description: While active, gains Energy when your Energy Shield is damaged by Enemy Hits. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnDodge.name: Cast on Dodge
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnDodge.description: While active, gains Energy when you dodge roll and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnMeleeS.name: Cast on Melee Stun
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnMeleeS.description: While active, gains Energy when you Stun enemies with Melee Attacks and triggers socketed spells on reaching maximum Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEnragedWarcr.name: Enraged Warcry I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEnragedWarcr.description: Supports Warcries, causing them to spend Rage to bypass their usual Cooldown.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEnragedWarcr.name: Enraged Warcry II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEnragedWarcr.description: Supports Warcries, causing them to spend Rage to bypass their usual Cooldown.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLingeringIll.name: Lingering Illusion
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLingeringIll.description: While active, creates a short-lived illusory copy of yourself whenever you dodge roll. The copy can be damaged by enemies, and copies that are destroyed by an enemy will drop a Remnant that grants you a Power Charge on pickup.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGhostDance.name: Ghost Dance
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGhostDance.description: While active, causes you to periodically gain Ghost Shrouds. If you are Hit while you have a Ghost Shroud, it is immediately consumed to recover Energy Shield based on your Evasion.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncestralWar.name: Ancestral Warrior Totem
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncestralWar.description: Consume 3 Endurance Charges to Raise a Totem that conjures spirit warriors. Each warrior uses a socketed Mace Skill once, then disappears. Cannot use Channelling Skills or Skills with Cooldowns.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncestralWar.tags: Attack, AoE, Melee, Duration, Conditional, Meta

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMetaSpellTot.name: Spell Totem
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMetaSpellTot.description: Consume any combination of 3 Power and/or Endurance Charges to raise a Totem that uses socketed Spells. Cannot use Skills with Cooldowns.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExplosiveGre.name: Explosive Grenade
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExplosiveGre.description: Fire a bouncing Grenade that unleashes a devastating fiery blast when its fuse expires.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlashGrenade.name: Flash Grenade
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlashGrenade.description: Fire a bouncing Grenade that unleashes a Blinding, Stunning explosion when its fuse expires.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOilGrenade.name: Oil Grenade
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOilGrenade.description: Fire a bouncing Grenade that bursts in a spray of Oil when the fuse expires or when it impacts an Enemy, dealing minimal damage but covering the ground and nearby enemies in Oil. Oil created this way can be Ignited by Detonator Skills or Ignited Ground.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemToxicGrenade.name: Gas Grenade
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemToxicGrenade.description: Fire a bouncing Grenade that causes a burst of Poison gas when its fuse expires, damaging enemies and leaving behind a growing Poison cloud. Burning effects or Detonator skills will cause the cloud to explode in a fiery blast.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemToxicGrenade.tags: AoE, Projectile, Grenade, Fire, Chaos, Duration

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockGrenade.name: Voltaic Grenade
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockGrenade.description: Fire a bouncing Grenade that discharges an Electrocuting Lightning blast when its fuse expires, causing all Lightning Hits against enemies to contribute to Electrocution buildup for a duration.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPainOffering.name: Pain Offering
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPainOffering.description:
Skewer a Skeleton on a bone spike to send nearby Minions into a frenzy as long as the spike remains, making their skills faster and harder hitting. 
The bone spike is itself a Minion. If it dies, the effect ends immediately.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTempestFlurr.name: Tempest Flurry
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTempestFlurr.description: Perform a series of aggressive Strikes. When used in quick succession, the third use Strikes three times, and the fourth use performs a Final Strike that calls down a powerful Shocking bolt.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStaggeringPa.name: Staggering Palm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStaggeringPa.description: Dash to an enemy and Strike them, instantly Heavily Stunning enemies which are Primed for Stun and performing additional dashing Strikes to other Primed targets in range if your first target was Stunned. Heavy Stunning an enemy with this Skill grants you a Buff that causes your Quarterstaff Attacks to also fire Projectiles for a short duration. Heavy Stunning additional enemies adds to the Buff's duration.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStaggeringPa.tags: Buff, AoE, Melee, Strike, Projectile, Physical, Duration, Wind

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChargedStaff.name: Charged Staff
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChargedStaff.description: Consume all Power Charges to charge your Quarterstaff with electricity, adding Lightning damage and a Lightning shockwave to your Quarterstaff Attacks. Reusing this skill while the Buff is active adds to the Buff's duration and damage.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChargedStaff.tags: Attack, Buff, AoE, Lightning, Duration, Conditional

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSiphoningStr.name: Siphoning Strike
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSiphoningStr.description: Dash to a target and Strike them with your Quarterstaff. If the target is Shocked, Consume their Shock to release a Lightning shockwave around the target and grant you a Power Charge. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTempestBell.name: Tempest Bell
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTempestBell.description: Build Combo by successfully Striking Enemies with other skills. After reaching maximum Combo, use this skill to cause the Bell on your staff to grow to massive size as you drop it on the ground. The Bell damages enemies on impact and can be Hit by your skills, creating a damaging shockwave. Elemental Ailments applied to the Bell cause its shockwaves to deal extra damage of the corresponding type, and Hits which would have caused Knockback increase the area of effect of the shockwaves.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChaosbolt.name: Chaos Bolt
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChaosbolt.description: Fire a burst of Chaos energy at the target.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCoilingBolts.name: Coiling Bolts
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCoilingBolts.description: Simultaneously fires a Physical Projectile and a Chaos Projectile at the target. These projectiles Chain through any number of Cursed targets.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrozenLocus.name: Frozen Locus
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrozenLocus.description: Leap backward and crack the ground with your staff to call forth an Ice Crystal which can be damaged by you and enemies. If the Crystal is destroyed it causes an icy explosion. This skill can be used while using other skills.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBonestorm.name: Bonestorm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBonestorm.description: Channel to conjure a swarm of bone spikes in the air, then release to fire them at enemies and explode. Shrapnel Impales enemies Hit, causing subsequent Attack Hits against those targets to deal extra damage. Consumes your Power Charges to cause much larger explosions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBoneCage.name: Bone Cage
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBoneCage.description: Raise a ring of bone spikes around you. The spikes are destroyed when enemies touch them, damaging and Pinning those enemies. Raising a new ring of spikes destroys the previous one.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemNeuralOverlo.name: Neural Overload
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemNeuralOverlo.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies. Nearby enemies are marked when they are Primed for Electrocution, and hitting a marked enemy with a supported skill will Electrocute them.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPinpointCrit.name: Pinpoint Critical
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPinpointCrit.description: Supports any skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to Critically Hit more often but deal less damage with Critical Hits.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPerpetualCha.name: Perpetual Charge
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPerpetualCha.description: Supports skills that consume Power, Frenzy or Endurance Charges on use, giving them a chance not to remove each Charge while still gaining the benefits of consuming them.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCorrosion.name: Corrosion
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCorrosion.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing Poison it applies to also Break enemy Armour. Cannot support skills that Consume Fully Broken Armour.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUnearth.name: Unearth
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUnearth.description: Raise spikes of bone from the earth in front of you, damaging enemies. The bones of Corpses and dead Reviving Minions in the area are ripped out and reassembled into short-lived Bone Construct Minions that fight for you. Larger Corpses create more than one Bone Construct.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDetonatingAr.name: Detonating Arrow
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDetonatingAr.description: Channel to charge up before firing off a burning arrow. At maximum stages, the arrow will create a Detonating explosion at the end of its flight.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDetonatingAr.tags: AoE, Projectile, Fire, Channelling, Detonator, Staged, Repeatable

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPoisonBurstA.name: Poisonburst Arrow
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPoisonBurstA.description: Fire a virulent arrow that creates a burst of Poison on hit, affecting all enemies in an area.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFirebolt.name: Firebolt
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFirebolt.description: Launch a fiery Projectile towards a target. The Projectile explodes on impact, damaging foes in a small area.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemToxicGrowth.name: Toxic Growth
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemToxicGrowth.description: Fire a rain of Toxic Pustules into the air. The Pustules deal damage on impact, then Detonate after a delay. They can also be Poisoned, causing them to Detonate faster and more violently.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStormcallerA.name: Stormcaller Arrow
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStormcallerA.description: Fire an arrow that embeds where it lands for a short duration. At the end of the duration, a Lightning Bolt strikes the arrow, disintegrating it and damaging enemies, with a high chance to Shock.
