Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfPlag.description: While active, killing a Poisoned enemy spreads its Poison to other nearby enemies, and has a chance to also Hinder them.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfBloo.name: Herald of Blood
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfBloo.description: While active, killing an enemy with Blood Loss will cause a bloody explosion that deals Physical Attack damage to surrounding enemies. This damage is not based on your Weapon, but is partially based on their accumulated Blood Loss. The explosion destroys their Corpse if the enemy was Normal or Magic, and has a chance to Aggravate Bleeding.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeraldOfBloo.tags: Attack, Persistent, AoE, Physical, Herald, Payoff

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWitheringPre.name: Withering Presence
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWitheringPre.description: While active, emits an Aura that periodically Withers enemies in your Presence.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRavenousSwar.name: Ravenous Swarm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRavenousSwar.description: While active and enemies are present, swarms of insects emerge from your body to pursue nearby enemies. The swarms are untargetable Minions that Attack and Poison enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMirageArcher.name: Mirage Archer
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMirageArcher.description: While active, dodge rolling will create a Mirage that uses socketed ranged Attacks for a short duration, then vanish.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCombatFrenzy.name: Combat Frenzy
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCombatFrenzy.description: While active, grants you a Frenzy Charge when you Freeze, Electrocute or Pin an enemy. This can only occur once every few seconds.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnBlock.name: Cast on Block
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnBlock.description: While active, gains Energy when you Block and triggers socketed Spells on reaching maximum Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastCurseOnB.name: Curse on Block
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastCurseOnB.description: While active, gains Energy when you Block and triggers socketed Curses on reaching maximum Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGatheringSto.name: Gathering Storm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGatheringSto.description: Flip backward and Channel to charge your Quarterstaff with Lightning. Releasing causes you to dash towards the target location, damaging enemies along the way. Releasing with Perfect Timing performs a Lightning-assisted dash that releases shockwaves from enemies you dash through. Perfectly Timed dash also explodes Tempest Bells on hit creating a shockwave that deals more damage and has a larger area, leaving Shocked Ground in its wake. This skill cannot be Ancestrally Boosted.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGatheringSto.tags: AoE, Melee, Lightning, Duration, Channelling, Travel

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBranchingFis.name: Branching Fissures I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBranchingFis.description: Supports Skills which create Fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional secondary Fissures which branch off from the primary fissure, with lowered area of effect and Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBranchingFis.name: Branching Fissures II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBranchingFis.description: Supports Skills which create Fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional secondary Fissures which branch off from the primary fissure, with lowered area of effect and Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUpheavalSupp.name: Upheaval I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUpheavalSupp.description: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create an additional fissure at the cost of damage and speed.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUpheavalSupp.name: Upheaval II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUpheavalSupp.description: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create additional fissures at the cost of damage and speed.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemKaomsMadness.name: Kaom's Madness
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemKaomsMadness.description: Supports Skills which create fissures in the ground, causing them to create many additional fissures at the cost of damage, speed, and area of effect.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLastingGroun.name: Lasting Ground
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLastingGroun.description: Supports Skills that create Ground Surfaces, causing those surfaces to last longer.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTerrainChain.name: Ricochet I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTerrainChain.description: Supports any Skill which creates Projectiles, giving those Projectiles a chance to Chain when impacting terrain.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTerrainChain.name: Ricochet II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTerrainChain.description: Supports any Skill which creates Projectiles, giving those Projectiles a chance to Chain when impacting terrain.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUrgentTotems.name: Urgent Totems I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUrgentTotems.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUrgentTotems.name: Urgent Totems II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUrgentTotems.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUrgentTotems.name: Urgent Totems III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUrgentTotems.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Skills to place Totems much more quickly. Totems created by Supported Skills have increased Attack and Cast Speed.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLongFuseSupp.name: Long Fuse I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLongFuseSupp.description: Supports Skills which have a Detonation Time, causing those Skills to have much higher Detonation Time and detonation damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLongFuseSupp.name: Long Fuse II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLongFuseSupp.description: Supports Skills which have a Detonation Time, causing those Skills to have much higher Detonation Time and detonation damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPayloadSuppo.name: Payload
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPayloadSuppo.description: Supports Skills which fire Grenades, giving fired Grenades a chance to activate again, but lengthening their cooldowns.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPotentExposu.name: Potent Exposure
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPotentExposu.description: Supports Skills which apply Exposure to Enemies, increasing the effect of applied Exposure.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemReinforcedTo.name: Reinforced Totems I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemReinforcedTo.description: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by Supported Skills have additional Elemental Resistances.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemReinforcedTo.name: Reinforced Totems II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemReinforcedTo.description: Supports Skills which create Totems. Totems created by Supported Skills have additional Elemental Resistances.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemConsideredCa.name: Considered Casting
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemConsideredCa.description: Supports Spell Skills that Hit Enemies and you cast yourself, boosting Damage at the cost of Cast Speed.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWildshardsSu.name: Wildshards I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWildshardsSu.description: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have a chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWildshardsSu.name: Wildshards II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWildshardsSu.description: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have a chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWildshardsSu.name: Sione's Temper
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWildshardsSu.description: Supports Projectile Spells. Supported Spells have an increasingly higher chance to fire many additional Projectiles in a circle, resetting when they do.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIcicleSuppor.name: Icicle
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIcicleSuppor.description: Supports any Skill which creates Ice Crystals, causing them to be created with lower Life.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGlacierSuppo.name: Glacier
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGlacierSuppo.description: Supports any Skill which creates Ice Crystals, causing them to be created with higher Life.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeftSupport.name: Heft
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeftSupport.description: Supports Skills which deal Damage, increasing the maximum Physical Damage of their Hits.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTempestuousT.name: Rising Tempest
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTempestuousT.description: Supports Skills which deal Damage, raising Elemental Damage dealt for each Skill used Recently of a different Elemental type. Cannot support Minion Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExtractionSu.name: Extraction
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExtractionSu.description: Supports Spell Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Using supported Spells will cause you to Sacrifice a portion of your Life on use, gaining extra Chaos Damage in exchange. Does not support Persistent Skills, Minion Skills, or Triggered Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAstralProjec.name: Astral Projection
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAstralProjec.description: Supports Nova Skills, causing those Skills to take place at the targeted location when used instead of around you.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPracticedCom.name: Practiced Combo
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPracticedCom.description: Supports Strike Skills. Supported Skills have a chance to build additional Combo on Hit. Cannot support Skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCulminationS.name: Culmination I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCulminationS.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills reset their Combo on use, dealing more Damage the higher Combo you had on use. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCulminationS.name: Culmination II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCulminationS.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills reset their Combo on use, dealing more Damage the higher Combo you had on use. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExpanseSuppo.name: Expanse
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExpanseSuppo.description: Supports any Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher Area of Effect but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExciseSuppor.name: Excise
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExciseSuppor.description: Supports any damaging Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher chance to Critically Hit, but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExecrateSupp.name: Execrate
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExecrateSupp.description: Supports any damaging Skill that you use yourself, granting it significantly higher chance to inflict Ailments on hit, but causing it to gain a long cooldown. Cannot support Skills which already have a cooldown.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEnergyRetent.name: Energy Retention
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEnergyRetent.description: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills gain a chance to partially Refund a portion of Energy cost when Triggering or Invoking other Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFerocitySupp.name: Ferocity
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFerocitySupp.description: Supports Skills that you use yourself. Supported Skills will consume a Frenzy Charge on use if possible, and will gain significant Skill Speed if they do, but cannot generate Frenzy Charges. Cannot Support Skills which consume Frenzy Charges.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSacrificialO.name: Sacrificial Offering
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSacrificialO.description: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills Sacrifice a portion of your life on use, but deal much more damage and have more powerful Buffs in return.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGuatelitzisA.name: Guatelitzi's Ablation
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGuatelitzisA.description: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills Sacrifice a portion of your life on use. While Offering spikes from Supported Skills persist, you are periodically granted a Power Charge. When spikes from Supported Skills die, Regenerate a percentage of your maximum Life and Mana per second based on the duration the Offering persisted.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDanseMacabre.name: Danse Macabre
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDanseMacabre.description: Supports Offering Skills. Supported Skills have increased Buff effect and deal more damage, but will target an additional skeletal Minion when cast. If there is not an additional skeletal Minion to target, no damage or Buff effect will be granted.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEnergyCapaci.name: Energy Capacitor
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEnergyCapaci.description: Supports Invocation Skills which Trigger other Skills. Supported Skills have significantly higher Maximum Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBoundlessEne.name: Boundless Energy I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBoundlessEne.description: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills generate Energy significantly faster.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBoundlessEne.name: Boundless Energy II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBoundlessEne.description: Supports Meta Skills. Supported Skills generate Energy significantly faster.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFleetingRemn.name: Harmonic Remnants I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFleetingRemn.description: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFleetingRemn.name: Harmonic Remnants II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFleetingRemn.description: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away, with a chance to create an additional Remnant.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlukeSupport.name: Fluke
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlukeSupport.description: Supports Skills which Trigger other Skills. Skills Triggered by Supported Skills have their Damage randomly raised or lowered when Triggered, as well as recovering a random amount of their cost when Triggered.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlukeSupport.name: Ixchel's Torment
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlukeSupport.description: Supports Skills which Trigger other Skills. Skills Triggered by Supported Skills have their Damage, Area of Effect, and Projectile Speed randomly raised or lowered when Triggered, as well as recovering a random amount of their cost when Triggered.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemZenithSuppor.name: Zenith I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemZenithSuppor.description: Supports Spell Skills. Supported Skills deal more damage while you are above 90% of your Maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemZenithSuppor.name: Zenith II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemZenithSuppor.description: Supports Spell Skills. Supported Skills have increased Mana cost Efficiency and deal more damage while you are above 90% of your maximum Mana. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBiddingSuppo.name: Bidding I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBiddingSuppo.description: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions deal more damage and have increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBiddingSuppo.name: Bidding II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBiddingSuppo.description: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions deal more damage and have increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBiddingSuppo.name: Bidding III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBiddingSuppo.description: Supports Minion Skills. Supported Minions have significantly increased Cooldown Recovery Rate with Command Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCommandmentS.name: Commandment
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCommandmentS.description: Supports Minions which have Command Skills. Supported Minions have massively increased cooldown recovery speed for Command Skills they use, but deal no damage with non-Command Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAdhesiveGren.name: Adhesive Grenades I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAdhesiveGren.description: Supports Grenade Skills. Grenades from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land, but doing lower damage when they detonate.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAdhesiveGren.name: Adhesive Grenades II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAdhesiveGren.description: Supports Grenade Skills. Grenades from Supported Skills do not bounce, instead halting movement where they intially land.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRetaliateSup.name: Retaliate I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRetaliateSup.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain much more damage the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRetaliateSup.name: Retaliate II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRetaliateSup.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain much more damage and are more capable of Stunning Enemies the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSalvoSupport.name: Salvo
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSalvoSupport.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which fire Projectiles, Sealing them over time. The Seals are broken when used, causing additional Projectiles to be fired. Projectiles from Supported Skills are fired in random directions. Cannot Support Skills which require Combo, have a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCadenceSuppo.name: Cadence
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCadenceSuppo.description: Supports Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills gain more Attack speed each time you use them, but will become unusable if used too frequently in a short time frame. Sustained Skills will instead gain Attack speed periodically while being used.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVoltSupport.name: Volt
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVoltSupport.description: Supports Projectile Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills gain Voltaic Charge as you move, up to a maximum. When used, Supported Skills expend that Charge to gain extra Lightning Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBoneShrapnel.name: Bone Shrapnel
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBoneShrapnel.description: Supports Skills which Hit Enemies. Supported Skills trigger Bone Shrapnel explosions when killing Pinned Enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAlignmentSup.name: Alignment I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAlignmentSup.description: Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction deal much more Damage. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAlignmentSup.name: Alignment II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAlignmentSup.description: Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction deal much more Damage. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAlignmentSup.name: Alignment III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAlignmentSup.description: Supports Bow Attacks. Supported Skills indicate one of four directions, changing indicated direction when an Attack with Supported Skill matches that direction. Attacks from Supported Skills which match the indicated direction fire additional Projectiles. Cannot Support Channelled Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDerangeSuppo.name: Derange
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDerangeSuppo.description: Supports Skills which you use yourself which can deal damage. Supported Skills gain an Energy Shield cost equal to your Intelligence, while also dealing more non-Ailment Damage over time based off of your Intelligence. Cannot support Channelling Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChargedShots.name: Charged Shots I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChargedShots.description: Supports Bow Attacks. Every third shot with Supported Skills restores a portion of its Mana cost and Gains Damage as extra Lightning Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChargedShots.name: Charged Shots II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChargedShots.description: Supports Bow Attacks. Every third shot with Supported Skills Gains Damage as extra Lightning Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemProfanitySup.name: Profanity I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemProfanitySup.description: Supports Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills consume a Corpse on use, dealing more Chaos Damage if they do.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemProfanitySup.name: Profanity II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemProfanitySup.description: Supports Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills consume many Corpses on use, dealing more Chaos Damage per Corpse consumed.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBurgeonSuppo.name: Burgeon I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBurgeonSuppo.description: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, causing them to deal more damage the longer they have been Channelled.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBurgeonSuppo.name: Burgeon II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBurgeonSuppo.description: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, causing them to deal more damage the longer they have been Channelled.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSteadfastSup.name: Steadfast I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSteadfastSup.description: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, granting you higher Stun Threshold while Channelling them.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSteadfastSup.name: Steadfast II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSteadfastSup.description: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself, granting you higher Stun Threshold and Ailment Threshold  while Channelling them.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlamepierceS.name: Flamepierce
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlamepierceS.description: Supports Skills which can fire Projectiles. Initial Projectile created by Supported Skills will always Pierce Ignited Enemies, but Supported Skills cannot inflict Ignite themselves.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFreezeForkSu.name: Freezefork
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFreezeForkSu.description: Supports Skills which can fire Projectiles. Projectiles from Supported Skills always Fork when the initial Projectile Hits Frozen Enemies, but Supported Skills cannot build up Freeze themselves.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStormchainSu.name: Stormchain
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStormchainSu.description: Supports Projectile Skills and Skills which can Chain. Supported Skills always Chain when initially Hitting a Shocked Enemy, but cannot themselves inflict Shock. Does not support Skills which cannot Chain.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVerglasSuppo.name: Verglas
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVerglasSuppo.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which can Hit Enemies. Supported Skills Gain a percentage of their Damage as Cold Damage when you destroy Ice Crystals.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEmbitterSupp.name: Embitter
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEmbitterSupp.description: Supports Skills which can Damage Enemies with Hits, causing all sources of Damage Gained to instead be treated as Damage Gained as extra Cold for Supported Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBattershoutS.name: Battershout
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBattershoutS.description: Supports Warcry Skills. Supported Skills Consume Fully Broken Armour to trigger Physical Damage explosions on Enemies within their range but cannot themselves Break Armour.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAbidingHexSu.name: Abiding Hex
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAbidingHexSu.description: Supports Curse Skills you cast yourself. Supported Skills will consume Power Charges on use, gaining significant Curse duration if they do. Cannot Support Skills which consume Power Charges.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRustedSpikes.name: Rusted Spikes
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRustedSpikes.description: Supports Skills which deal Damage with Hits. When Supported Skills Pin an Enemy, they also Aggravate Bleeding on that Enemy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCrazedMinion.name: Crazed Minions
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCrazedMinion.description: Supports Minion Skills which summon Reviving Minions. Supported Minions deal significantly more Damage if they have Revived Recently.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpectralVoll.name: Spectral Volley
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpectralVoll.description: Supports Bow or Spear Projectile Attacks you use yourself. Supported Skills deal lower damage initially, but generate Spectral Projectiles, which deal more damage when they fire. Spectral Projectiles linger and will fire a short duration after no new Spectral Projectiles have been created. Cannot support Channelling Skills, Leaping skills, or skills which rain Projectiles from above.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDeathmarchSu.name: Deathmarch
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDeathmarchSu.description: Supports Skills which create Persistent Minions. Supported Minions will restore Life to nearby Allied Minions on death, as well as removing Ailments from those Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAcrimonySupp.name: Acrimony
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAcrimonySupp.description: Supports Skills which can Damage Enemies. Enemies affected by Damage over time from Supported Skills which was not caused by a Damaging Ailment have reduced Life regeneration rate. Only the strongest instance of this Debuff will apply. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemConcoctSuppo.name: Concoct I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemConcoctSuppo.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which Damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Life Flask charges, inflicting more powerful Bleeding based on Life Flask charges consumed.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemConcoctSuppo.name: Concoct II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemConcoctSuppo.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which Damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Life Flask charges, inflicting more powerful Bleeding based on Life Flask charges consumed.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAmbrosiaSupp.name: Ambrosia
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAmbrosiaSupp.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Mana Flask charges, Gaining a percentage of damage as extra Lightning damage per Mana Flask charge consumed.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAmbrosiaSupp.name: Ambrosia II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAmbrosiaSupp.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which damage enemies with Hits. Supported Skills consume a percentage of your maximum Mana Flask charges, Gaining a percentage of damage as extra Lightning damage per Mana Flask charge consumed.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPersistentGr.name: Persistent Ground I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPersistentGr.description: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPersistentGr.name: Persistent Ground II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPersistentGr.description: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer and only end when their duration expires.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPersistentGr.name: Persistent Ground III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPersistentGr.description: Supports Skills which create Ground Surfaces, causing created Surfaces to last much longer as well as lowering the Cooldown Recovery Speed of affected Enemies. Ground Surfaces from Supported Skills only end when their duration expires.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSelflessRemn.name: Selfless Remnants
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSelflessRemn.description: Supports Skills that generate Remnants, causing those Remnants to affect Allies in your Presence when collected instead of you.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRemnantPoten.name: Remnant Potency I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRemnantPoten.description: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRemnantPoten.name: Remnant Potency II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRemnantPoten.description: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful, but delaying their effect.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRemnantPoten.name: Remnant Potency III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRemnantPoten.description: Supports Skills which create Remnants, making those Remnants more powerful, but delaying their effect.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemReverberateS.name: Reverberate
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemReverberateS.description: Supports Slam Skills. Supported Skills that have a chance to Aftershock have increased chance to cause Aftershocks the longer their Attack time.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemClashSupport.name: Clash
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemClashSupport.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills deal more Damage while you have a lower percentage of your Life remaining than the target struck, but less Damage when the reverse is true.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMaladySuppor.name: Malady
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMaladySuppor.description: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits, causing base chance to inflict Bleeding with Supported Skills to instead apply to base chance to Poison, and causing base chance to Poison to instead apply to Bleeding.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSyzygySuppor.name: Syzygy
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSyzygySuppor.description: Supports Slam Skills you use yourself. Hits from Supported Skills are considered Crushing Blows against Enemies which are both Ignited and Fully Armour Broken. Hits with Supported Skills that Heavily Stun Ignited and Fully Armour Broken Enemies will Intimidate them.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOverextendSu.name: Overextend
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOverextendSu.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills deal more Damage with Critical Hits, but Critically Hitting an Enemy with them will Daze you for a short time.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRetreatSuppo.name: Retreat I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRetreatSuppo.description: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRetreatSuppo.name: Retreat II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRetreatSuppo.description: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRetreatSuppo.name: Retreat III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRetreatSuppo.description: Supports Skills which create Projectiles. Supported Skills deal more damage with Projectiles if you have struck with a Melee Hit in the last two seconds, but cannot themselves deal Melee Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPursuitSuppo.name: Pursuit I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPursuitSuppo.description: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPursuitSuppo.name: Pursuit II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPursuitSuppo.description: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last eight seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPursuitSuppo.name: Pursuit III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPursuitSuppo.description: Supports Melee Attacks. Supported Skills deal more Melee damage if you have struck with a Projectile Attack Hit in the last two seconds, but cannot themselves deal Projectile Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOverreachSup.name: Overreach
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOverreachSup.description: Supports Attack Skills which deal Damage in an Area. Supported Skills have significantly increased Area of Effect, but are less Accurate against nearby targets.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCommiserateS.name: Commiserate
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCommiserateS.description: Supports Skills you use or Trigger yourself, which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills inflict more powerful Ailments if you are afflicted with those Ailments when you inflict them, while also removing from you any Ailment that they inflict.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBlindsideSup.name: Blindside
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBlindsideSup.description: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills are more likely to Critically Hit Blinded Enemies, and deal more Damage with Critical Hits against Blinded Enemies, but cannot themselves inflict Blind.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHitAndRunSup.name: Hit and Run
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHitAndRunSup.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which do not already have some Condition for use. Supported Skills can only be used after you have moved a certain distance, but have massively increased Skill Speed. Cannot support Skills which have a cooldown.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCracklingBar.name: Crackling Barrier
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCracklingBar.description: Supports Channelling Skills. While Channelling Supported Skills, you gain Lightning Thorns based off of your maximum Mana.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDefySupport.name: Defy I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDefySupport.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Hit Damage from Supported Skills is Lucky if you are Surrounded.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDefySupportT.name: Defy II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDefySupportT.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Hit Damage from Supported Skills is Lucky and Insufficient Mana doesn't prevent Supported Skills from being used if you are Surrounded.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolatilitySu.name: Volatility
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolatilitySu.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills grant Volatility on Critical Hit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMusterSuppor.name: Muster
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMusterSuppor.description: Supports Skills which summon Minions. Supported Minions deal more Damage the more different kinds of Reviving Minions you have summoned.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHulkingMinio.name: Hulking Minions
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHulkingMinio.description: Supports Skills which summon Persistent Minions. Supported Minions are larger, have more Life, and deal more Damage, but cost significantly more Spirit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCaltropsSupp.name: Caltrops
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCaltropsSupp.description: Supports Ranged Spear Attacks. Supported Skills create Caltrops when Projectiles they create reach the end of their flight.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCaltropsSupp.tags: Attack, AoE, Projectile, Trigger, Duration, Hazard

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHaemocrystal.name: Haemocrystals
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHaemocrystal.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills Consume Bleeding on Hit to create explosive blood-filled crystals, but cannot themselves inflict Bleeding. Cannot Support Skills which already Consume Bleeding.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSparSupport.name: Spar
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSparSupport.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills are more capable of Stunning Enemies the closer you are to being Heavily Stunned.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDauntlessSup.name: Dauntless
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDauntlessSup.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills cannot be used unless you have been stationary for a certain duration, but deal increasingly more damage the longer you are stationary. Cannot support Skills which have a cooldown or another usage Condition.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMagneticRemn.name: Magnetic Remnants
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMagneticRemn.description: Supports Skills which create Remnants, allowing those Remnants to be collected from further away.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncestralCal.name: Ancestral Call I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncestralCal.description: Supports Strikes you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds. Cannot Support Channelled Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncestralCal.name: Ancestral Call II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncestralCal.description: Supports Strikes you use yourself, providing a powerful Ancestral Boost every few seconds. Cannot Support Channelled Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemQuillburstSu.name: Quill Burst
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemQuillburstSu.description:
Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills trigger Quill Burst, which deals your Thorns Damage in an Area around the target struck. Quill Burst can only be triggered on Hit after you've
Retaliated with Thorns Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncestralAid.name: Ancestral Aid
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncestralAid.description: Supports Strikes you use yourself. Supported Skills cannot be used until you have Blocked a certain number of Hits, but will be Ancestrally Boosted when used. After use, this Blocked Hit counter will reset. Cannot Support Channelled Skills or Skills which already have a Condition for use.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockingLeap.name: Shocking Leap
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockingLeap.description: Supports Skills that leap into the air and deal damage, causing them to create Shocked Ground the first time they Critically Hit an enemy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBarbsSupport.name: Barbs I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBarbsSupport.description: Supports Melee Strike Skills. After you Retaliate with Thorns Damage, you also deal your Thorns damage to enemies you Hit with Supported Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBarbsSupport.name: Barbs II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBarbsSupport.description: Supports Melee Strike Skills. After you Retaliate with Thorns Damage, you also deal your Thorns damage to enemies you Hit with Supported Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBarbsSupport.name: Barbs III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBarbsSupport.description: Supports Melee Strike Skills. After you Retaliate with Thorns Damage, you also deal your Thorns damage twice to enemies you Hit with Supported Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArmsLengthSu.name: Arms Length
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArmsLengthSu.description: Supports Skills which Hit Enemies, causing Knockback from those Hits to be significantly more effective.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCharmBountyS.name: Charm Bounty
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCharmBountyS.description: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing Enemies it kills to grant more Charm charges.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemThornskinSup.name: Thornskin I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemThornskinSup.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Thorns Damage while the Supported Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemThornskinSup.name: Thornskin II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemThornskinSup.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Thorns Damage while the Supported Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMysticismSup.name: Mysticism I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMysticismSup.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Spell Damage while on full Energy Shield while the Supported Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMysticismSup.name: Mysticism II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMysticismSup.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Spell Damage while on full Energy Shield while the Supported Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDirestrikeSu.name: Direstrike I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDirestrikeSu.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Attack Damage while on Low Life while the Supported Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDirestrikeSu.name: Direstrike II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDirestrikeSu.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to deal increased Attack Damage while on Low Life while the Supported Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUpwellingSup.name: Upwelling I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUpwellingSup.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing your Minions to deal increased Damage while you are not on full Mana while the Supported Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUpwellingSup.name: Upwelling II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUpwellingSup.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing your Minions to deal increased Damage while you are not on full Mana while the Supported Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWarmBloodedS.name: Warm Blooded
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWarmBloodedS.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Freeze applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCoolHeadedSu.name: Cool Headed
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCoolHeadedSu.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Ignite applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStrongHearte.name: Strong Hearted
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStrongHearte.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing Shock applied to you to last for a shorter duration while the Supported Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUntouchableS.name: Untouchable
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUntouchableS.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. While using Supported Skills, you gain increased Evasion Rating, with the increase scaling higher the longer the Attack time of the supported Skill. Cannot Support Channelling Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRefractionSu.name: Refraction I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRefractionSu.description: Supports Banner Skills, causing those affected by Auras they create to gain Refractive Plating, a Buff which grants Deflection Rating and causes Armour to partially apply to Elemental Hit Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRefractionSu.name: Refraction II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRefractionSu.description: Supports Banner Skills, causing those affected by Auras they create to gain Refractive Plating, a Buff which grants Deflection Rating and causes Armour to partially apply to Elemental Hit Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRefractionSu.name: Refraction III
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRefractionSu.description: Supports Banner Skills, causing Enemies within their area to gain Refractive Dissolution, a Debuff which lowers Elemental Resistances.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCirelsCultiv.name: Cirel's Cultivation
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCirelsCultiv.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing you from having more than one of that Totem but granting significant benefits for Supported Totems based how many allied Totems are near them. Does not Support Skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSplinteringT.name: Splinter Totem I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSplinteringT.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing having more than one active Totem but causing that Totem to splinter into smaller versions of itself after it uses an Attack or Spell, with each Totem becoming less effective. Each splintered Totem can further splinter, up to a maximum. Does not Support Skills used by Minions. Only one Totem can be splintering at a time.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSplinteringT.name: Splinter Totem II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSplinteringT.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, preventing having more than one active Totem but causing that Totem to splinter into smaller versions of itself after it uses an Attack or Spell, with each Totem becoming less effective. Each splintered Totem can further splinter, up to a maximum. Does not Support Skills used by Minions. Only one Totem can be splintering at a time.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPunchThrough.name: Punch Through
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPunchThrough.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills apply Easy Target when Knocking Back Enemies, causing the next Projectile Attack Hit they take to deal increased Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRipSupport.name: Rip
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRipSupport.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills you use or Trigger yourself. Killing Blows with Supported Skills on Bleeding enemies create a Blood Remnant. Blood Remnants increase your Life regeneration rate for a short while after being collected.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTearSupport.name: Tear
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTearSupport.description: Supports Melee Attacks you use or Trigger yourself. On-Kill effects caused by Killing Blows with Supported Skills on Bleeding enemies have a chance to occur twice.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBrinkSupport.name: Brink I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBrinkSupport.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills build up Heavy Stun more quickly, but cannot themselves Heavy Stun.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBrinkSupport.name: Brink II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBrinkSupport.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills build up Stun more quickly, but cannot themselves Stun.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTirelessSupp.name: Tireless
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTirelessSupp.description: Supports Warcry Skills. Attacks Empowered by Supported Skills have a chance not to lower the Empowerment count of Supported Skills when they are used.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolcanicErup.name: Volcanic Eruption
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolcanicErup.description: Supports Melee Strike Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills trigger Volcanic Eruption on Hit against Ignited Enemies.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVolcanicErup.tags: Attack, AoE, Melee, Strike, Projectile, Trigger, Fire

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrenziedRipo.name: Frenzied Riposte
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrenziedRipo.description: Supports Attacks you use or Trigger yourself, causing them to Consume the Parried Debuff on Hit to grant you a Frenzy Charge. Cannot support Skills which already Consume the Parried Debuff.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeightenedCh.name: Heightened Charges
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeightenedCh.description: Supports any Skill that Consumes Charges, granting a chance for benefits of that Consumption to be doubled.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIncisionSupp.name: Incision
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIncisionSupp.description: Supports Attack Skills. Supported Skills inflict Incision on Hit, which causes Enemies to be increasingly more likely to be inflicted with Bleeding. All Incision is removed from a target on inflicting it with Bleeding.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCatharsisSup.name: Catharsis
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCatharsisSup.description: Supports any Skill you use yourself, causing supported Skill to detonate Volatility that is present on you. Supported Skill can only be used while you have a certain amount of Volatility and cannot support Skills which already have another Condition.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDelayedGrati.name: Delayed Gratification
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDelayedGrati.description: Supports Skills which require some Condition to be met for use. Supported Skills can be used an additional time after their Condition has been met, but meeting that Condition is harder.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLoyaltySuppo.name: Loyalty
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLoyaltySuppo.description: Supports Skills that create Companions which can be damaged. Minions created by Supported Skills take a portion of Hit Damage you would otherwise have taken, but have lowered maximum Life.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRomirasRequi.name: Romira's Requital
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRomirasRequi.description: Supports Skills that create Companions which can be damaged. Minions created by Supported Skills take a portion of Hit Damage you would otherwise have taken, but have lowered maximum Life. A percentage of Damage taken this way is Recouped by you as Life.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRearmSupport.name: Rearm I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRearmSupport.description: Supports Skills which create Hazards. Hazards created by Supported Skills have a chance to be rearmed a short duration after triggering.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRearmSupport.name: Rearm II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRearmSupport.description: Supports Skills which create Hazards. Hazards created by Supported Skills have a chance to be rearmed a short duration after triggering.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDelayedReact.name: Delayed Reaction
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDelayedReact.description: Supports Skills which create Hazards, causing those Hazards to only be able to trigger immediately after creation or at the end of their duration. Created Hazards have significantly lowered duration, and deal more damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGambleshotSu.name: Gambleshot
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGambleshotSu.description: Supports Skills which fire Projectiles that are not ground targeted. Projectiles from Supported Skills randomly Fork, Chain or Pierce.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUnerringPowe.name: Unerring Power
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUnerringPowe.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. When Supported Attacks are Empowered, they have significantly lowered cost and raised Accuracy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemImpaleSuppor.name: Impale
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemImpaleSuppor.description: Supports Attacks, causing them to Impale on Hit but making them unable to Extract Impale themselves.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPerfectionSu.name: Perfection
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPerfectionSu.description: Supports skills which have a benefit for Perfectly Timing their use. On successfully executing Perfect Timing with Supported Skills, gain Perfection, which is a powerful damage buff. However, failing to execute any Perfect Timing (even with skills not supported by Perfection) will remove all Perfection on you.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDeliberation.name: Deliberation
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDeliberation.description: Supports skills that can be used while moving, causing you to move slower while using them, but granting more damage in exchange.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShortFuseSup.name: Short Fuse I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShortFuseSup.description: Supports Skills which Detonate after some amount of time has elapsed, shortening the time before Detonation.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShortFuseSup.name: Short Fuse II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShortFuseSup.description: Supports Skills which Detonate after some amount of time has elapsed, massively shortening the time before Detonation at the cost of Damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUndermineSup.name: Undermine
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUndermineSup.description: Supports Attack Skills. Supported Skills Consume Maim on hit, Breaking a percentage of the Maimed target's Armour in doing so. Supported Skills cannot themselves inflict Maim.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMarkForDeath.name: Mark for Death
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMarkForDeath.description: Supports Mark Skills. Enemies affected by Supported Marks will have their Armour Broken by Physical Damage they take.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMarkForDeath.name: Mark for Death II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMarkForDeath.description: Supports Mark Skills. Enemies affected by Supported Marks will have their Armour Broken by Physical Damage they take.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAdmixtureSup.name: Admixture
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAdmixtureSup.description: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Bleeding inflicted by those Hits is more effective against Poisoned Enemies, and Poison inflicted by Supported Skills is more effective against Bleeding Enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStoicismSupp.name: Stoicism I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStoicismSupp.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills steadily gain more Damage, up to a cap. This Damage bonus is reset if you Dodge Roll or use a Travel Skill.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStoicismSupp.name: Stoicism II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStoicismSupp.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself. Supported Skills steadily gain more Damage, up to a cap. This Damage bonus is reset if you Dodge Roll or use a Travel Skill.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRelentlessRa.name: Relentless Rage
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRelentlessRa.description: Supports Skills you use yourself. On spending Rage with any skill you will gain a Buff. Using Supported Skills consumes this Buff to grant you Rage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBrambleslamS.name: Brambleslam
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBrambleslamS.description: Supports Slam Skills, making them Trigger Brambles to create Hazardous brambles which damage and Maim enemies. Does not modify Skills used by Minions or Totems.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBrambleslamS.tags: Attack, AoE, Melee, Slam, Trigger, Physical, Hazard, Plant

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChargeInhibi.name: Inhibitor
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChargeInhibi.description: Supports any Skill you use or Trigger yourself. Supported Skills cannot consume Charges or Infusion by any means. Cannot Support Skills which require Charges or Infusion to be used.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStaticShocks.name: Static Shocks
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStaticShocks.description: Supports Skills which can Hit enemies. Shocking an enemy with Hits from Supported Skills Triggers Static Shocks, causing that enemy to become a source of Lightning damage sending pulses towards nearby enemies.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStaticShocks.tags: Spell, AoE, Trigger, Sustained, Lightning, Duration

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHardyTotemsS.name: Hardy Totems I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHardyTotemsS.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHardyTotemsS.name: Hardy Totems II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHardyTotemsS.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHardyTotemsS.name: Tawhoa's Tending
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHardyTotemsS.description: Supports Skills which create Totems, causing those Totems to have more Life. Totems created by Supported Skills explode on death, dealing Physical damage based on their Life.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEncroachingG.name: Encroaching Ground
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEncroachingG.description: Supports Skills that create Ground Surfaces, causing those Surfaces to grow over time, up to a limit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUniqueBreach.name: Lightning Bolt
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUniqueBreach.description: Call down a Shocking bolt of Lightning to strike enemies in a small area.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWhirlwindLan.name: Whirlwind Lance
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWhirlwindLan.description: Throw a Spear with enough force to kick up a Whirlwind where it lands, Slowing enemies and Blinding them in its area of effect. Entering the Whirlwind collapses it, dealing damage and causing Knockback. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to create the Whirlwind with one more than its normal maximum number of stages.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPrimalStrike.name: Primal Strikes
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPrimalStrike.description: Perform a Lightning-charged stab that can be chained into a combination of up to three attacks. The first two attacks conjure a charging Wildwood spirit if they Hit a Shocked enemy and refresh Shock duration. The third attack is a large swipe that inflicts Elemental Exposure, and can Consume Shock to conjure a stampede of spirits.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCullTheWeak.name: Cull The Weak
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCullTheWeak.description: Dash to an enemy and run them through, Culling enemies if their life is low enough. If this Attack kills at least one enemy, it grants you a Frenzy Charge, with higher Rarity monsters granting additional Charges. Enemies around you that can be Culled will be highlighted.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFangsOfFrost.name: Fangs of Frost
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFangsOfFrost.description: Perform an icy stab that exploits enemies who are already off balance. Hitting a Parried target Consumes the Debuff to cause an explosion of frost and leave Chilled Ground.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWindSerpents.name: Wind Serpent's Fury
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWindSerpents.description: Consume all Frenzy Charges to perform a gigantic spear thrust that Knocks Back enemies. For each Frenzy Charge consumed, a Wind Serpent follows in the spear's wake. Each Serpent also damages and Knocks Back enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRake.name: Rake
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRake.description: Dash towards an enemy and perform a lacerating slash, inflicting Bleeding on all enemies struck.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBloodhoundsM.name: Bloodhound's Mark
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBloodhoundsM.description: Mark a target, making them suffer Heavy Stun build up from Blood Loss. The Mark will Activate, Consuming itself to Trigger Blood Explosion, when they are Heavy Stunned, or when they are killed if they suffered enough Blood Loss. The Mark's duration does not expire while the Marked target is suffering Blood Loss.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBloodhoundsM.tags: Attack, AoE, Trigger, Physical, Duration, Payoff

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTameBeast.name: Tame Beast
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTameBeast.description: Conjure Azmeri wisps to engulf a Rare Beast for a duration, Hindering them. If you defeat the Beast while it is engulfed in wisps, it will be captured by this gem, transforming the gem to instead allow you to summon the Beast as a Reviving Companion.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpearOfSolar.name: Spear of Solaris
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpearOfSolar.description: Build Glory by inflicting Freeze, Shock or Ignite on enemies. When you have maximum Glory you may call forth the Azmeri goddess Solaris, jumping backwards and throwing your Spear in the air. On landing the spear deals heavy damage in an area, then calls a divine skybeam that pulses periodically and creates expanding Ignited Ground. Modifiers to number of Projectiles fired do not apply to this skill.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStormLance.name: Storm Lance
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStormLance.description: Throw an electrified Spear that lodges in the ground and periodically zaps nearby enemies with Lightning bolts. If the Spear is Detonated by another Skill, it immediately unleashes a volley of bolts and expires. Consumes a Frenzy Charge if possible to fire bolts more frequently for a shorter duration, automatically Detonate at the end of its duration, and create Shocked Ground on Detonation.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStormLance.tags: AoE, Projectile, Sustained, Lightning, Duration, Repeatable

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemParry.name: Parry
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemParry.description: Ready your Buckler to parry the next Hit you would take, Blocking the Hit and retaliating with a quick sweep that leaves enemies off balance, causing them to take massively increased Attack damage for a short duration. Parrying causes you to accumulate Heavy Stun buildup. You cannot Evade a Hit you could parry, but Evasion instead grants an equal chance to avoid this Heavy Stun buildup.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemElementalSun.name: Elemental Sundering
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemElementalSun.description: Plunge your Spear into the ground to emit a pulse that Consumes Freeze, Shock and Ignite on a number of nearby enemies, Allies and Corpses. The pulse itself deals no damage, but each Ailment Consumed causes an explosion of the corresponding elemental damage type.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemElementalSun.tags: AoE, Melee, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Nova, Payoff

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSummonBeast.name: Companion: {0}
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSummonBeast.description: Summon a Reviving Beast Companion to aid you in combat.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnCharmU.name: Cast on Charm Use
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastOnCharmU.description: While active, gains Energy when one of your Charms is used and triggers socketed Spells on reaching maximum Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTrinity.name: Trinity
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTrinity.description: Become attuned to all Elements building up Fire, Cold and Lightning Affinity based off the highest Elemental Damage type dealt by your Hits. Your Elemental Damage is enhanced the more Affinity of any type you have.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTrailOfCaltr.name: Trail of Caltrops
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTrailOfCaltr.description: While active, scatters caltrops in your wake when you dodge.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTrailOfCaltr.tags: Buff, Persistent, AoE, Projectile, Trigger, Physical, Duration, Hazard

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyTr.name: Elemental Surge
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyTr.description: Grants your weapon Surges. Non-Melee Projectile Attacks with that weapon Consume Surges to cause the Projectiles fired to explode at the end of their flight.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChaosSpearTr.name: Chaotic Surge
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChaosSpearTr.description: Grants your weapon Surges. Non-Melee Projectile Attacks with that weapon Consume Surges to cause the Projectiles fired to explode at the end of their flight.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastLightnin.name: Thundergod's Wrath
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCastLightnin.description: While active, gains Energy when you Hit enemies with Melee Attacks and triggers socketed Lightning spells on reaching maximum Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemConvalescenc.name: Convalescence
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemConvalescenc.description: While active, grants a skill that you can use to instantly begin Recharging Energy Shield and gain a Buff for a duration that prevents that Recharge being interrupted. The Buff is removed at maximum Energy Shield and the skill cannot be used while Energy Shield is full.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGeminiSurge.name: Gemini Surge
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGeminiSurge.description: Grants your weapon Surges. Non-Melee Projectile Attacks with that weapon Consume Surges to cause the Projectiles fired to explode at the end of their flight.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWingBlast.name: Wing Blast
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWingBlast.description: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and launch yourself backwards with a powerful wingbeat that Knocks Back enemies. Enemies Primed for Heavy Stun will be stunned, release a shockwave, and have a chance to grant you a Power Charge. This skill can be used while using other skills to interrupt them.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExplodingPoi.name: Bursting Fen Toad
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExplodingPoi.description: This skill creates a toad that jumps around briefly, the toad then explodes, dealing Attack damage in an area and inflicting Poison.  Damage you deal with this skill is not based on your Weapon.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOilBarrage.name: Oil Barrage
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOilBarrage.description: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and spit Oil at enemies, creating Oil Ground where the Projectiles land. Consumes Power Charges if possible to instead Channel a sustained barrage of electrified Oil that does not create Oil Ground. Projectiles are fired in sequence, allowing multiple Projectiles to Hit the same target.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOilBarrage.tags: Shapeshift, Wyvern, AoE, Projectile, Sustained, Channelling

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIronWard.name: Iron Ward
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIronWard.description: While active, stores a percentage of the Physical damage that is prevented by your Armour or other sources of damage reduction. Using this Skill releases the stored damage as a nova of spikes.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWyvernFlameB.name: Flame Breath
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWyvernFlameB.description: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and take to the skies, immolating enemies with a jet of fire. Channelling ends after a short amount of time but can be prolonged by spending Rage. Consumes a Power Charge if possible to Empower the Skill, Gaining extra Lightning damage and spending Rage more slowly.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWyvernFlameB.tags: Shapeshift, Wyvern, AoE, Sustained, Fire, Duration, Channelling, Detonator

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEntangle.name: Entangle
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEntangle.description: Conjures a rootbound fissure that crawls forward, damaging enemies in its path. While the fissure persists, vines lash out from it and attach to nearby enemies, damaging and Slowing them.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEntangle.tags: AoE, Sustained, Physical, Duration, Repeatable, Plant

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfShred.name: Shred
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfShred.description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and lash out with a flurry of claw swipes. The first Attack can dash to faraway enemies and the final Attack Strikes twice. Attacking a Frozen enemy will create Ice Fragments, which are Projectiles that land and explode after a short delay.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfShred.tags: Shapeshift, Werewolf, AoE, Melee, Strike, Projectile, Trigger, Cold, Payoff

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBearFuryOfTh.name: Fury of the Mountain
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBearFuryOfTh.description: Shapeshift into a Bear and repeatedly pound the ground, creating Molten Fissures that travel randomly in a wide arc in front of you.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBearFuryOfTh.tags: Shapeshift, Bear, AoE, Melee, Slam, Sustained, Duration, Channelling

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfCrossSla.name: Cross Slash
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfCrossSla.description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and leap backwards as you gouge the ground with both claws. Enemies can be Hit separately by both gouges. Hitting a Marked enemy with both gouges will Activate the Mark and cause an additional shockwave. Ice Fragments will be pulled into the location where the gouges cross and explode. immediately. This skill can be used while using other skills to interrupt them.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIcestorm.name: Icestorm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIcestorm.description: Conjure a hail of icy bolts over the targeted area. Chill and Freeze on enemies in front of you are Consumed to fuel the Icestorm by creating improved bolts.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIcestorm.tags: AoE, Sustained, Cold, Duration, Payoff, Repeatable, Storm

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPinnacleOfPo.name: Pinnacle of Power
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPinnacleOfPo.description: Consume all Power Charges to master the elements, gaining Elemental Damage and the ability to apply Elemental Ailments with other damage types. Can only be used while you have maximum Power Charges.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPinnacleOfPo.tags: Buff, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Duration, Conditional

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCrossbowRequ.name: Requiem
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCrossbowRequ.description: Your weapon passively accumulates anguish from the tormented souls within. When fully charged, use this skill to compose the Requiem, transforming your Crossbow shot into a torrent of anguish for a short, fixed amount of time. Does not use Ammunition.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLunarAssault.name: Lunar Assault
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLunarAssault.description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and swipe with your claws, projecting an arc of moonlight and ice forward in a crescent.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLunarAssault.tags: Shapeshift, Werewolf, AoE, Melee, Strike, Cold

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeartOfIce.name: Heart of Ice
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeartOfIce.description: Chills all enemies in your Presence.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWyvernDevour.name: Devour
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWyvernDevour.description: Shapeshift into a Wyvern and devour a Corpse or Cullable enemy, and additional nearby Corpses. For each enemy or corpse devoured, you regenerate life and gain a Power Charge. If the target is far enough away, you will leap to them and damage nearby enemies where you land. Targeting nearby enemies or corpses will not perform a leap or a Slam.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemThrashingVin.name: Thrashing Vines
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemThrashingVin.description: Spur the growth of huge vines, which emerge randomly within the target area. The vines crash to the ground then retreat, targeting nearby enemies if possible.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfLunarBle.name: Lunar Blessing
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfLunarBle.description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and offer your Rage to the moon to receive a blessing, gaining bonus Cold damage for yourself and any Wolf Minions you have from Wolf Pack or Predator's Mark. Spends all Rage to extend the Buff's duration. While the Buff is active, your Werewolf Melee Attacks call down Moonbeams on Hit.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfLunarBle.tags: Attack, Shapeshift, Buff, Werewolf, AoE, Trigger, Cold, Duration

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfArcticHo.name: Arctic Howl
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfArcticHo.description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and let out an icy howl that damages enemies and Freezes Primed enemies. If an enemy is Frozen or a Frozen enemy is Hit, this Skill Empowers your attacks with added Cold damage, causes Empowered Slams to create Chilled Ground, and grants your Allies added Cold damage. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending an Endurance Charge.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWolfArcticHo.tags: Shapeshift, Buff, Werewolf, AoE, Cold, Duration, Nova

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLivingLightn.name: Living Lightning
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLivingLightn.description: Supports Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Living Lightning Minions are created when dealing Lightning damage with Supported Skills - bundles of living electricity that target nearby enemies with Chaining Attacks. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLivingLightn.name: Living Lightning II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLivingLightn.description: Supports Skills which cause Damaging Hits. Living Lightning Minions are created when dealing Lightning damage with Supported Skills - bundles of living electricity that target nearby enemies with Chaining Attacks. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrozenSpiteS.name: Frozen Spite
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrozenSpiteS.description: Supports Skills that Hit enemies, causing them to create Ice Fragments on killing Frozen Enemies. Cannot Support Totem Skills and does not modify Skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockingRift.name: Electromagnetism
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockingRift.description: Supports Skills that Hit enemies. When Supported Skills Shock an enemy that is nearby other Shocked enemies, trigger Electromagnetism, sucking in nearby enemies, Hindering them, and dealing Lightning damage at an interval.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemShockingRift.tags: Spell, AoE, Trigger, Sustained, Lightning, Payoff

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPietysMercyS.name: Dominus' Grasp
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPietysMercyS.description: Supports Projectile skills and any other skills that Chain, causing them to Chain more times.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlamePillarS.name: Flame Pillar
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFlamePillarS.description: Supports any Skill you use yourself which can cause Damaging Hits. Supported Skills Consume Ignite on Hit to create pillars of flame, but cannot themselves inflict Ignite. Cannot Support Skills which already Consume Ignite, and does not modify the Skills of Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStreamlinedR.name: Streamlined Rounds
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStreamlinedR.description: Supports Crossbow Ammunition Skills. Supported Skills have significantly higher Attack speed and bolt capacity, but deal less damage and have longer reload time.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPerfectEndur.name: Perfected Endurance
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPerfectEndur.description: Supports skills which have a benefit for Perfect Timing. Supported Skills grant at least one Endurance Charge when Hitting an enemy with Perfect Timing.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeavyStunEnd.name: Enduring Impact I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeavyStunEnd.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to gain an Endurance Charge when causing a Heavy Stun.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeavyStunEnd.name: Enduring Impact II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHeavyStunEnd.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, giving it a chance to gain an Endurance Charge when causing a Heavy Stun.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCraterSuppor.name: Crater
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCraterSuppor.description: Supports Melee Skills that leap into the air, causing them to create Fissures when you land. Cannot Support Totem Skills, and does not modify Skills used by Minions.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCraterSuppor.tags: Attack, AoE, Melee, Trigger, Fire, Duration

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVanguardSupp.name: Vanguard I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVanguardSupp.description: Supports Shield Skills, causing you to gain Guard on Stunning Enemies with the Supported Skill.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVanguardSupp.name: Vanguard II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVanguardSupp.description: Supports Shield Skills, causing you to gain Guard on Stunning Enemies with the Supported Skill.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCrystallineS.name: Crystalline Shards
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCrystallineS.description: Supports Skills which create Ice Crystals. Damaging Explosions caused by Ice Crystals from Supported Skills will Impale Enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkitteringSt.name: Skittering Stone I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkitteringSt.description: Supports Skills which create shatterable earthen objects. After killing enough Enemies in range of these objects, they will shatter, releasing skittering stone Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkitteringSt.name: Skittering Stone II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkitteringSt.description: Supports Skills which create shatterable earthen objects. After killing enough Enemies in range of these objects, they will shatter, releasing skittering stone Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDiallasDesir.name: Dialla's Desire
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDiallasDesir.description: Supports any Skill which has levels, increasing the level and Quality, while reducing the cost and Reservation.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemKalisasCresc.name: Kalisa's Crescendo
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemKalisasCresc.description: Supports Curse Skills. Enemies Cursed by Supported Skills are Pacified for the final portion of the Supported Curse's duration.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDurabilitySu.name: Durability
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDurabilitySu.description: Supports Skills which create objects that are destroyed after being Hit a number of times, allowing for them to last for additional Hits. Does not modify Skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemXophsPyreSup.name: Xoph's Pyre
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemXophsPyreSup.description: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Ignites.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEshsRadiance.name: Esh's Radiance
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEshsRadiance.description: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Shock.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTulsStillnes.name: Tul's Stillness
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTulsStillnes.description: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Contribute to Freeze Buildup.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUulNetolsEmb.name: Uul-Netol's Embrace
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUulNetolsEmb.description: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, granting extra Chaos damage and causing Chaos damage to Break Armour.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRakiatasFlow.name: Rakiata's Flow
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRakiatasFlow.description: Supports Skills that can cause Damaging Hits, causing those Hits to treat Enemy Elemental Resistances as inverted.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRigwaldsFero.name: Rigwald's Ferocity
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRigwaldsFero.description: Supports Attack skills, granting them Attack Speed at the cost of Damage or Damage at the cost of Attack Speed depending on Weapon Set they are used in. Does not modify skills used by Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUhtredExodus.name: Uhtred's Exodus
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUhtredExodus.description: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them many additional levels provided no other supports are used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUhtredOmenSu.name: Uhtred's Omen
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUhtredOmenSu.description: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them additional levels provided exactly one other support is used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUhtredAugury.name: Uhtred's Augury
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUhtredAugury.description: Supports Skills which can gain levels, granting them additional levels provided exactly two other supports are used with the supported Skill. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDaressosPass.name: Daresso's Passion
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDaressosPass.description: Supports Banner Skills, causing them to require significantly less Glory to use.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAtzirisAllur.name: Atziri's Allure
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAtzirisAllur.description: Supports Curse Spells you cast yourself, causing those Curses to ignore the usual Curse Limit, but be reflected back to you when inflicted.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAtzirisCommu.name: Atziri's Communion
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAtzirisCommu.description: Supports Persistent Skills, making them Reserve Life instead of Spirit. Cannot Support Skills which create Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAtzirisImpat.name: Atziri's Impatience
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAtzirisImpat.description: Supports Skills you use yourself that have Cooldowns, dramatically increasing the rate at which those Cooldowns Recover, but causing you to lose Life, Mana, and Energy Shield when they are used. Cannot Support Meta Skills or Persistent Skills, or modify the Skills of Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTacatisIreSu.name: Tacati's Ire
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTacatisIreSu.description: Supports Skills which can cause Damaging Hits. Poison inflicted with Supported Skills deals Damage faster the higher your Rage.
