Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemZarokhsRefra.name: Zarokh's Refrain
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemZarokhsRefra.description: Supports Cascadable Spells you cast yourself. Supported Spells Echo thrice, but are given a Cooldown. Cannot support skills which already have a Cooldown.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGarukhansRes.name: Garukhan's Resolve
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGarukhansRes.description: Supports Attack Skills you use yourself which do not already have some Condition for use. Supported Skills have a maximum Critical Hit chance, but will Bifurcate Critical Hit Chance.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemKurgalsLeash.name: Kurgal's Leash
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemKurgalsLeash.description: Supports Commandable Minions causing you and the Supported Minion to gain Unholy Might when you Command them.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemKulemaksDomi.name: Kulemak's Dominion
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemKulemaksDomi.description: Supports Offering Skills, causing your Cascadable Spells to Cascade to the locations of Supported Offerings.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAmanamusTith.name: Amanamu's Tithe
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAmanamusTith.description: Supports Persistent Minion Skills, granting a chance when Supported Minions die for you to gain an Abyssal Monster Modifier.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVarashtasBle.name: Varashta's Blessing
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVarashtasBle.description: Supports any Skill that can deal damage, causing it to deal more damage for each different Command Skill you have used in the past few seconds. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArbitersIngi.name: Arbiter's Ignition
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArbitersIngi.description: Supports Fire Spell Skills causing you to gain Elemental Archon when Igniting with them.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArakaalisLus.name: Arakaali's Lust
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArakaalisLus.description: Supports any Skill that Hits Enemies, causing it to deal increasingly higher damage the more Poisons are on the target.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTasaliosRhyt.name: Tasalio's Rhythm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTasaliosRhyt.description: Supports Skills which have a benefit for Perfectly Timing their use. On successfully executing Perfect Timing with Supported Skills, gain Tasalio's Rhythm. Tasalio's Rhythm causes Supported Skills to deal more damage and have shorter Perfect Timing windows for each stack. Failing to execute any Perfect Timing (even with skills not supported by Tasalio's Rhythm) will remove all Tasalio's Rhythm on you.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemXibaquasRend.name: Xibaqua's Rending
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemXibaquasRend.description: Supports Skills that leap into the air, causing Corpses in the area you land to violently explode, damaging surrounding enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemKhatalsRejuv.name: Khatal's Rejuvenation
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemKhatalsRejuv.description: Supports Skills that generate Remnants. Picking up Remnants from Supported Skills grants Khatal's Rejuvenation.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMorganasTemp.name: Morgana's Tempest
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMorganasTemp.description: Supports Storm skills, increasing their Limit and causing them to move quickly from the user to the target location, but become less effective. Cannot Support Triggered Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemForgeHammer.name: Forge Hammer
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemForgeHammer.description: Hurl a fiery hammer that Slams into the ground and lodges there. While the hammer is lodged in the ground, reusing this Skill recalls the hammer and resets the Skill's cooldown. Alternatively, using a Warcry near the lodged hammer causes it to shatter, releasing a number of Molten Fissures in a spiral.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFulmination.name: Fulmination
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFulmination.description: While active, the first time any Skill Hits a Shocked enemy in your Presence, that Skill also Hits other Shocked enemies in your Presence, up to a maximum.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMortarCannon.name: Mortar Cannon
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMortarCannon.description: Raise a cannon Ballista Totem which uses socketed Grenade Skills, with significantly improved Cooldown Recovery Rate.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncestralCry.name: Ancestral Cry
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncestralCry.description: Perform a Warcry using Glory gained by Igniting enemies to turn you into an embodiment of Kaom. While embodying Kaom, you Trigger Volcanic Steps while travelling, Melee Strikes and Slams are Ancestrally Boosted, and your Melee Strikes Trigger Volcanic Eruption.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncestralCry.tags: Attack, Buff, AoE, Melee, Slam, Projectile, Trigger, Fire, Duration, Nova, Conditional

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPrimalBounty.name: Primal Bounty
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPrimalBounty.description: Empowers the next Projectile Skill you use, causing it to create additional Projectiles and fly faster.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFeastOfFlesh.name: Feast of Flesh
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFeastOfFlesh.description: Consume Corpses near you to recover Life and Mana over a short time per Corpse Consumed.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemToxicDomain.name: Toxic Domain
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemToxicDomain.description: Create an area of Toxic Bloom on the ground around you. While in the Bloom, you have increased Skill costs, Regenerate Life, and your Projectile Attacks attach a Toxic Pustule, which can be Poisoned. Pustules will Detonate after a duration or when enough Poison has been applied, dealing more damage based on the stored Poison damage and applying Poison in an area around it.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemToxicDomain.tags: Attack, AoE, Physical, Chaos, Duration, Plant

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpellslinger.name: Spellslinger
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpellslinger.description: While active, gains Energy when you cast Spells. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to trigger socketed Spells, and can trigger them multiple times if it has enough Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceTippedArr.name: Ice-Tipped Arrows
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceTippedArr.description: Ready your active Bow or Spear, Empowering your next Repeatable Bow or Projectile Spear Attacks to Convert Physical Damage to Cold Damage and Trigger Ice Fragments on Hit. This Skill's cooldown can be bypassed by expending a Frenzy Charge. Cannot Empower Sustained Skills.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemIceTippedArr.tags: Attack, Buff, AoE, Projectile, Trigger, Cold, Duration

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCracklingPal.name: Crackling Palm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCracklingPal.description: When you Hit with Unarmed Melee Attacks, calls down lightning bolts which deal Unarmed Attack damage to all surrounding enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFuturePast.name: Future-Past
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFuturePast.description: Hinekora observes your Future-Past granting you the opportunity to subvert a lesser fate. After a period of Hindsight, she will grant you her Foresight, which prevents you from avoiding Hits while Dodge Rolling. When you are Hit while Dodge Rolling, Hinekora restores you to full Life immediately before taking damage from the Hit, and grants you Sight Beyond Sight, which prevents you from dying.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRunicTemperi.name: Runic Tempering
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRunicTemperi.description: Channel to imbue your armour with Runic Plates. When you are Hit while you have these plates, some of the damage you would take will be prevented, and this skill will cause backlash, dealing your Thorns damage in an area around your attacker.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHisWinnowing.name: His Winnowing Flame
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHisWinnowing.description: Conjure an abyssal scythe that sweeps across the targeted area, dealing Fire damage to enemies and Consuming Ignite to create pillars of flame. Cannot be Triggered.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHisFoulEmerg.name: His Foul Emergence
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHisFoulEmerg.description: Conjure a horrific skull rising from the lightless depths to bite your enemies dealing high damage at target location and leaving Withering Ground in its wake. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSiphonElemen.name: Siphon Elements
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSiphonElemen.description: While active, has a chance to create an Infusion Remnant when you Freeze, Shock or Ignite a target.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostDarts.name: Frost Darts
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostDarts.description: Conjures a number of icy Projectiles that launch towards the target. Projectiles that Hit a Chilled or Frozen target create chunks of ice that deal additional damage on impacting the ground. Consumes a Cold Infusion if possible to cause each Projectile to lodge into the enemy then explode.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTriggeredAby.name: Abyssal Apparition
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTriggeredAby.description: Consume a Power Charge when you cast a damaging Spell to trigger an Abyssal Apparition who will also cast that same Spell for you. Does not work with Channelling Spells, Spells with a Cooldown, Triggered Spells, Spells granted by items, or Spells which already consume a Power Charge. This Skill is not directly Supportable.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCreepingChil.name: Creeping Chill
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCreepingChil.description: Supports any Skill that creates Ice Crystals, causing that Skill to Consume a Power Charge if possible to create Chilled Ground around the Crystal.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBriarpatch.name: Briarpatch
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBriarpatch.description: While active, a portion of the Physical Attack damage you deal is stored. Casting a Spell uses the stored damage to create a patch of Thorny Ground that deals Spell damage to moving enemies.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBriarpatch.tags: Spell, Persistent, AoE, Sustained, Physical, Duration, Plant

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEternalRage.name: Eternal Rage
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEternalRage.description: While active, you constantly regenerate Rage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSavageFury.name: Savage Fury
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSavageFury.description: While active, your Fury builds from Attacking enemies. Using this Skill releases your Fury to send you into a bestial frenzy, gaining damage and Onslaught but constantly losing life and forcing you into animal form. The frenzy ends immediately if you return to human form. You cannot gain Fury while in a frenzy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWalkingCalam.name: Walking Calamity
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWalkingCalam.description: Build Glory by gaining Rage while already at maximum Rage. When you have maximum Glory, roar to the heavens to bring them down upon your enemies. For the duration of the Skill, meteors rain down around you and you Gain Fire damage and Rage regeneration. This Skill's effects are suppressed if you leave Bear form, but will resume if you return to Bear form before the duration expires.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWalkingCalam.tags: Shapeshift, Buff, Bear, AoE, Trigger, Fire, Duration, Conditional

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTheStarsAnsw.name: The Stars Answer
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTheStarsAnsw.description: Leash the stars themselves by leveraging your vast magical power, repeatedly Triggering Starfall targeting an enemy in an area around you, or a random location in that area if no enemies can be targeted.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTheStarsAnsw.tags: Buff, AoE, Trigger, Physical, Cold, Duration

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemApocalypse.name: Apocalypse
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemApocalypse.description: Build Glory by Hitting enemies with Elemental damage. When you have maximum Glory, you may become the walking Apocalypse for a duration, Triggering one of multiple powerful Elemental Skills at an interval while this Buff lasts.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemApocalypse.tags: Spell, AoE, Trigger, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Duration, Conditional, Storm

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMarkOfSiphon.name: Mark of Siphoning
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMarkOfSiphon.description: Supports Mark Skills, causing enemies they Mark to Leech Mana to you when you Hit them with Attacks.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMarkOfSiphon.name: Mark of Siphoning II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMarkOfSiphon.description: Supports Mark Skills, causing enemies they Mark to Leech Life and Mana to you when you Hit them with Attacks.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemThrillOfTheK.name: Thrill of the Kill
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemThrillOfTheK.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Culling a Shocked enemy with Supported Skills infuses all of your Attacks with Lightning damage for a short time.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemThrillOfTheK.name: Thrill of the Kill II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemThrillOfTheK.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Culling a Shocked enemy with Supported Skills infuses all of your Attacks with Lightning damage and grants an increased chance to Shock for a short time.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExposingCryS.name: Exposing Cry
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExposingCryS.description: Supports Warcries. Supported Skills apply Exposure on Hitting enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOpeningMoveS.name: Opening Move
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOpeningMoveS.description: Supports Travel Skills which Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills against enemies on full life will Daze.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExplosiveGro.name: Accelerated Growth
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExplosiveGro.description: Supports Plant Skills, causing them to Trigger an explosion after they have been Overgrown.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExplosiveGro.name: Accelerated Growth II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExplosiveGro.description: Supports Plant Skills, causing them to Trigger an explosion after they have been Overgrown, Blinding enemies Hit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFanTheFlames.name: Fan The Flames
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFanTheFlames.description: Supports Wind Skills which Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills against Ignited enemies Trigger a fiery explosion, dealing damage to that enemy and enemies in a cone behind them.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFanTheFlames.name: Fan The Flames II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFanTheFlames.description: Supports Wind Skills which Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills against Ignited enemies Trigger a fiery explosion, dealing damage to that enemy and enemies in a cone behind them. The explosion Spreads the initial enemy's Ignite to other enemies Hit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDeadlyCurren.name: Coursing Current
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDeadlyCurren.description: Supports Skills which Hit enemies. Shocking an enemy with Supported Skills Triggers Coursing Current, which sends Chaining Lightning Projectiles to nearby Drenched enemies.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMirrorOfRefr.name: Mirror of Refraction
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMirrorOfRefr.description: Mirrors of Refraction appear in your Presence periodically. Hitting a mirror with a Spell Projectile causes it to shatter, copying the projectiles in a nova around the destroyed mirror. Copied Projectiles may be copied again when colliding with other mirrors.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBarkskin.name: Barkskin
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBarkskin.description: While active, taking Hit damage from enemies to your Energy Shield causes you to gain Armour for a short duration. Armour gained from multiple Hits can stack. The total Armour gained from this Skill cannot exceed the Item Armour on your Equipped Armour Items.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFeralInvocat.name: Feral Invocation
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFeralInvocat.description: While active, gains Energy when you spend Mana. Using the Invocation once sufficient Energy is gathered will consume the Energy to create visages which attack once with a socketed Shapeshifting Attack, creating multiple visages if it has enough Energy.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPoisonSpores.name: Poison Spores
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPoisonSpores.description: Supports Plant Skills which Hit enemies. Supported Skills Trigger Toxic Pustule on Hitting an enemy.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPoisonSpores.tags: Attack, Buff, AoE, Trigger, Physical, Chaos, Duration, Plant

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDangerousRes.name: Deadly Resolve
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDangerousRes.description: Supports Channelling Skills you use yourself. While Channelling Supported Skills, periodically gain stages of Deadly Resolve. Expend a stage of Deadly Resolve when an enemy Hits you to Trigger a deadly slash towards that enemy, dealing more damage based on your Armour.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDangerousRes.tags: Attack, AoE, Trigger, Physical, Channelling, Staged

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAdvancingSto.name: Advancing Storm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAdvancingSto.description: Supports Storm skills, causing them to appear at the user's location and move towards the target location.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEchoingCrySu.name: Echoing Cry
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEchoingCrySu.description: Supports Warcries. Supported Skills Echo twice, and their area grows larger each time, but are less effective and require you to have travelled a certain distance before use.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGorgeSupport.name: Gorge
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGorgeSupport.description: Supports skills that consume Corpses. Consuming Corpses with supported skills grants Flask charges.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEmpoweredSpa.name: Empowered Sparks I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEmpoweredSpa.description: Supports Skills which generate Charges. When generating Power Charge with Supported Skills, Empower some of your Attacks to Trigger Spark Projectiles on use.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemControlledHa.name: Controlled Hazard
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemControlledHa.description: Supports Skills which create Hazards, causing those Hazards to be unable to be triggered for 3 seconds after being created.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBrittleArmou.name: Brittle Armour
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBrittleArmou.description: Supports Skills which can Hit enemies. Hits with Supported Skills which Freeze enemies cause Physical damage against them to Break their Armour while they remain Frozen.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRendingApexS.name: Rending Apex
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRendingApexS.description: Supports Strikes that perform a Final Strike at the end of a combination of attacks, causing the Final Strike to Break Armour based on a portion of Attack damage dealt.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPracticalMag.name: Practical Magic I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPracticalMag.description: Supports Skills which Hit enemies. Heavy Stunning an enemy with Supported Skills increases your Spell damage for a duration.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPracticalMag.name: Practical Magic II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPracticalMag.description: Supports Skills which Hit enemies. Heavy Stunning an enemy with Supported Skills increases your Spell damage for a duration.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBlazingCriti.name: Blazing Critical
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBlazingCriti.description: Supports Skills you use yourself which Hit enemies. Critical Hits with Supported Skills imbue all of your Attacks with Fire damage for a duration.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemConcussiveSp.name: Concussive Spells
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemConcussiveSp.description: Supports Spells which Hit enemies. Supported Skills Daze on Critically Hitting enemies with Physical damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEternalMarkS.name: Eternal Mark
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEternalMarkS.description: Supports Mark Skills, causing them to not be Consumed the first time they are Activated.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCatalysingEl.name: Catalysing Elements
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCatalysingEl.description: Supports Skills which are boosted by Elemental Ground Surfaces, Triggering Catalysing Discharge of the corresponding type when they are boosted by an allied Elemental Ground Surface.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCatalysingEl.tags: Spell, AoE, Trigger, Lightning, Cold, Fire

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemNovaProjecti.name: Nova Projectiles II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemNovaProjecti.description: Supports Projectile Skills, making them fire extra Projectiles in a circle, at the cost of Damage and gaining a cooldown. Does not Support Skills which rain down Projectiles from above. Cannot Support Skills which already have a cooldown.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChargedMarkS.name: Charged Mark
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemChargedMarkS.description: Supports Mark Skills, causing them to Trigger Charged Mark when they are Activated. Charged Mark creates Shocked Ground at the target's location.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMinionMeleeS.name: Minion Splash I
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMinionMeleeS.description: Supports Skills which create Minions which Strike, causing those Minions' Strikes to have Melee Splash.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMinionMeleeS.name: Minion Splash II
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMinionMeleeS.description: Supports Skills which create Minions which Strike, increasing their Area of Effect and causing those Minions' Strikes to have Melee Splash.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArchonOfChay.name: Archon of Chayula
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArchonOfChay.description: Build Glory by dealing Chaos damage to enemies. When you have maximum Glory, you can entreat the Dreamer to inhabit you, briefly becoming his Archon.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArchonOfChay.tags: Attack, AoE, Trigger, Physical, Chaos, Duration, Conditional, Storm

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncientGifts.name: Wildwood's Gifts
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAncientGifts.description: You are chosen by Azmerian spirits who provide guidance, allowing you to see nearby Ancient Blooms.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStarbornOnsl.name: Starborn Onslaught
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStarbornOnsl.description: Build up Glory by Freezing or Chilling enemies. When you have maximum Glory you may jump backwards loosing your Mace with the force of a falling comet onto your target. The impact releases Fissures and causes stars to fall in the area for a brief period.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStarbornOnsl.tags: AoE, Melee, Slam, Physical, Cold, Duration

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAzmerianSwar.name: Azmerian Swarms
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAzmerianSwar.description: While active, summons short-lived Azmerian Swarms when you kill enemies affected by Elemental Ailments or hit Rare or Unique enemies affected by Elemental Ailments. The swarms are untargetable Minions that pursue nearby enemies to Attack them and inflict Faerie Fire on Hit.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAzmerianSwar.tags: Minion, Persistent, Physical, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Duration

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHarbingerOfM.name: Harbinger of Madness
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHarbingerOfM.description: Draws out the latent fears of enemies you kill and Rare or Unique enemies you Hit, turning them into unstable apparitions which charge towards enemies and then explode.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemNightfallShi.name: Soaring Midnight
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemNightfallShi.description: Hurl your Shield as a Projectile which Returns to you at the end of its flight. While the Shield is in flight, this skill is replaced with Embrace the Fall. This skill's cooldown is skipped if you catch the Shield as it Returns, or destroy an Ice Crystal with the Embrace the Fall.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemNightfallShi.tags: AoE, Melee, Slam, Projectile, Physical, Cold, Travel

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpiritVessel.name: Spirit Vessel
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSpiritVessel.description: Summons a Shapeshifting Spirit Vessel Companion that uses copies of socketed Bear, Werewolf, and Wyvern Skills.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHerDeclarati.name: Her Declaration
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHerDeclarati.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing enemies that enter your Presence to become Intimidated while the Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPrototypeSev.name: Prototype Seventeen
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPrototypeSev.description: Supports non-Channelling skill you use yourself that Hits enemies, causing it to gain Critical Hit chance based on Rage, but also remove all Rage upon Critically Hitting.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSeraphsHeart.name: Seraph's Heart
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSeraphsHeart.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, providing a chance for enemies to calculate their Hits as though your Resistances were 90% while the skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUhtredsRiteS.name: Uhtred's Rite
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUhtredsRiteS.description: Supports skills with Cooldowns, causing them to grant Overflowing Chalice when used. Supported skills deal more damage during the effect of your Life Flask and have increased Mana Cost Efficiency during the effect of your Mana Flask.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTrickstersSh.name: Trickster's Shard
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTrickstersSh.description: Supports non-instant Spells you cast yourself. Supported Spells will Trigger Fragment Self, creating a Fractured Mimic which will cast that Spell if you get enough of them.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArbitersReac.name: Arbiter's Reach
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemArbitersReac.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you periodically grant Guard to allies in your Presence while the Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTangmazusThu.name: Tangmazu's Thurible
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTangmazusThu.description: Supports Skills which summon Companions causing them to be Gigantic and gain Evasion and Deflection based on your own.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMidnightStar.name: Midnight Zenith
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMidnightStar.description: While active, Critical Hits with other skills that kill targets, or hit powerful targets cause you to gain Arctic Petals. Once you have enough Arctic Petals they will be Consumed to create Ice Crystals near the most recent target.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEshsProwessS.name: Esh's Prowess
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEshsProwessS.description: Supports Lightning skills that Hit targets, granting them an additional level and causing them to only roll the minimum or maximum value for Lightning damage. Does not support skills which do not have levels.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBreachlordsR.name: Breachlord's Rift
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBreachlordsR.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing it to Break Armour of enemies it Freezes or Electrocutes.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBreachlordsA.name: Breachlord's Amalgam
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBreachlordsA.description: Supports Lightning or Cold skills you use yourself which fire Projectiles and do not already have cooldowns, adding a cooldown and making the Projectiles return, piercing through targets as they do so.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVruunsAfterm.name: Vruun's Aftermath
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVruunsAfterm.description: Supports Warcries, causing them to destroy Ice Crystals and Ice Fragments. Supported Skills empower additional Attacks if they destroy enough Ice Crystals and Ice Fragments.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVruunsInevit.name: Vruun's Inevitability
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVruunsInevit.description: Supports Melee Attack Skills. Supported Skills gain Combo when you successfully Strike Enemies with other Melee Attacks. Supported Skills expend their Combo when used, gaining more area of effect the higher Combo they had. Cannot support skills which already gain Combo. Cannot modify the Skills of Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUhtredsConst.name: Uhtred's Constellation
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUhtredsConst.description: Supports non-instant skills which have a cooldown, granting them two additional cooldown uses and more damage per different skill with a cooldown you have used recently.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMedvedsFelli.name: Medved's Felling
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMedvedsFelli.description: Supports Melee Attacks you use yourself, causing them to attack faster the more Rage you have and grant Rage on Hit, but also making you lose Life based on your Rage when using them.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVoranasSiege.name: Vorana's Siege
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVoranasSiege.description: Supports skills which Hit targets and have an area of effect, increasing the affected area and causing it to Hit Isolated targets harder.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStyrnsMounta.name: Styrn's Mountain
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStyrnsMounta.description: Supports Skills that Raise your Shield causing your other melee skills to deal more damage if you block.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStyrnsFeroci.name: Styrn's Ferocity
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemStyrnsFeroci.description: Supports Shield Skills that Hit enemies, causing those Hits to Crush their targets, additionally causing any Physical Damage Hits against those targets while Crushed to Break their Armour.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCathasBrilli.name: Catha's Brilliance
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemCathasBrilli.description: Supports skills which create Companions, causing enemies near them to be Blinded and Ignited. The damage of the Ignite is based on the Life of the supported Minion.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMorrigansIns.name: Morrigan's Insight
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMorrigansIns.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing them to deal more damage and trigger Nature's Exchange when consuming Freeze on enemies. Cannot support skills that Consume Freeze.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTulsAvalanch.name: Tul's Avalanche
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTulsAvalanch.description: Supports Cascadable Spells you cast yourself, Sealing them when you Block, The Seals are broken when used, each making the Spell Echo. Cannot support skills with a Cooldown or which already gain Seals.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyGe.name: Virtuous Barrier
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAscendancyGe.description: While active, conjures a glittering barrier that accumulates protective gemstone Motes of each Attribute type over time, but loses a random Mote when you are Hit.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemConcussiveRu.name: Concussive Runes
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemConcussiveRu.description: Supports Attacks, causing a Runic Shockwave to erupt under enemies they Heavy Stun. The Shockwave costs Runic Ward, and will not Trigger if you do not have enough Runic Ward.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLeylines.name: Leylines
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemLeylines.description: While active, areas of intense runic energy are revealed to you. Standing over them grants you a powerful Spell damage boost but constantly drains your Runic Ward. Running out of Runic Ward causes the energy to temporarily dissipate.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostflameNo.name: Frostflame Nova
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFrostflameNo.description: Unleash a wave of volatile ice that feeds on flames. While the wave doesn't deal damage, the ice latches onto Ignited enemies, refreshing the duration of their active Ignite and rapidly Freezing them but preventing them from being Ignited further until the Ignite expires.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHollowShell.name: Hollow Shell
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHollowShell.description: Sacrifice your Runic Ward to send out an energy pulse that grants nearby Allies Guard.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMoltenShower.name: Molten Shower
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemMoltenShower.description: Fires molten Projectiles from the enemy hit, which will explode when they land nearby, dealing Attack damage in an area.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRunicInfusio.name: Runic Infusion
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRunicInfusio.description: Supports Attacks you use or Trigger yourself, causing them to cost Runic Ward to use but deal additional Physical damage based on their Runic Ward cost. Cannot Support Channelling Skills, Sustained Skills, or Skills without a cost.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRuneforgedBl.name: Runeforged Blades
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRuneforgedBl.description: Supports Attacks you use yourself, causing them to Consume Fully Broken Armour on enemies to fire a nova of runic Projectiles at the cost of Runic Ward. The Projectiles cannot Hit the enemy from which they originated. Cannot support skills that Consume Broken Armour.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPoweredByVer.name: Powered by Verisium
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemPoweredByVer.description: Spends Ward to generate Verisium Infusions, which can be used in place of any Elemental Infusions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRefutation.name: Refutation
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRefutation.description: Spends all your Runic Ward to gain a short-duration Buff that causes you to Block all Blockable Hits and apply Parried to enemies from which you've Blocked a Hit. This Buff is removed if you are Heavy Stunned. While this Buff is active, you cannot be Light Stunned, but Blocking too much damage may Heavy Stun you.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRepulsion.name: Repulsion
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRepulsion.description: Spend Runic Ward to Curse enemies with a Verisium Rune, inflicting them with Fragility. Hitting these enemies removes the Curse to Trigger an explosion, Knocking Back nearby enemies and causing more Stun buildup based on the Fragility on the target Hit.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRepulsion.tags: Attack, AoE, Trigger, Physical, Duration, Curse, Repeatable

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTriskelionCa.name: Triskelion Cascade
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemTriskelionCa.description: Tap into the power of the Triskelion Flame to Empower the next Cascadable Spell you cast. The Empowered Spell becomes centred on your location, and Cascades to six areas around you in a Triskelion pattern.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGelidPalm.name: Gelid Palm
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGelidPalm.description: When you Hit with Unarmed Melee Attacks, projects icy wind which deal Unarmed Attack damage to all surrounding enemies and destroy Ice Crystals.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkyfall.name: Skyfall
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkyfall.description: Build Glory by spending Runic Ward. When you have maximum Glory, you may call down a mass of Verisium from the sky, dealing high damage at the targeted location and summoning a Temporary Minion. Targeting close to you will cause you to jump back as you cast. Consumes a Verisium Infusion, if possible, to increase the number of Minions summoned.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSkyfall.tags: Minion, AoE, Physical, Cold, Conditional, Repeatable

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDetonateLivi.name: Detonate Living
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemDetonateLivi.description: Spend Runic Ward to cause a destabilising Hit against an enemy under the Culling Strike Threshold, making them violently explode. Highlights enemies under the Culling Strike Threshold.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAnimusExchan.name: Animus Exchange
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAnimusExchan.description: Sacrifice a portion of your Life to recover Runic Ward. Runic Ward recovered by this Skill can Overflow.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBitterDead.name: Bitter Dead
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemBitterDead.description: Spend Ward and target an area, transforming Corpses into bitter cores that seek out enemies and Chill enemies near them. The cores explode at the end of their duration, creating runes which deal additional Cold damage over time.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEternalMarch.name: Eternal March
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemEternalMarch.description: Spend Runic Ward to instantly Revive your Minions. Prioritises the most powerful minions first.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGrimPillars.name: Grim Pillars
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemGrimPillars.description: Spend Runic Ward to cause damaging Ice-Crystal spears to erupt from the ground around you. These spears can be destroyed for an explosion of Cold damage.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVerisiumMani.name: Verisium Manifestations
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVerisiumMani.description: While active, Hitting with an Attack will spend Runic Ward to summon a Verisium Manifestation, a short-lived Temporary Minion that rapidly Attacks nearby enemies, ignoring commands. Enemies will not directly engage these Minions, and can pass through them.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRemnantsOfKa.name: Remnants of Kalguur
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRemnantsOfKa.description: While active, enemies you Stun or kill have a chance to generate a Runic Ward Remnant. These Remnants can Overflow your Runic Ward.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWardboundMin.name: Wardbound Minions
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemWardboundMin.description: Spend all your Runic Ward to summon Temporary Wardbound Casters. These Minions target nearby enemies with damaging Cold Spells.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRunicExtract.name: Runic Extraction
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRunicExtract.description: Supports any Skill that deals damage. Enemies you kill with supported Skills have a chance to drop a Verisium Infusion Remnant.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFragmentsOfT.name: Fragments Of The Past
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFragmentsOfT.description: Spend Runic Ward to create a Verisium volcano that deals damage on initial eruption and Triggers Ice Fragments.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFragmentsOfT.tags: AoE, Projectile, Trigger, Sustained, Cold, Duration

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemConductiveRu.name: Conductive Runes
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemConductiveRu.description: Spend Runic Ward to create a number of Hazardous Runes in a cone in front of you, which arm after a time. After arming, these Runes will activate when enemies step on them, exploding to deal Attack damage that is not based on your Weapon's damage and apply Electrocution buildup.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUniqueAtziri.name: Herald of the Royal Queen
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUniqueAtziri.description: Killing an enemy with Blood Loss will cause a bloody explosion that deals Physical Attack damage to surrounding enemies. This damage is not based on your Weapon Damage, but is based on their accumulated Blood Loss. The explosion destroys their Corpse if the enemy was Normal or Magic.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemUniqueAtziri.tags: Attack, Persistent, AoE, Physical, Herald, Payoff

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAnimusSplint.name: Animus Splinters
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemAnimusSplint.description: Expend a large amount of Runic Ward to instantly create a short-lived copy of yourself that uses a Socketed Skill once, then vanishes. This Skill's cost is equal to the total cost of Socketed Skills. The copy cannot perform Channelled, Remote, Cooldown or Conditional Skills, or summon Minions.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemScouringFlam.name: Scouring Flame
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemScouringFlam.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, causing inflicted Ignites to deal more damage but the skill to gain a Runic Ward cost.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRunicRepriev.name: Runic Reprieve
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRunicRepriev.description: Channel to create a protective bubble all around you, Blocking Hits against you. While Channelling this Skill, you cannot be Light Stunned by Hits you Block, and damage you take from Hits is also removed from Runic Ward. Blocking Hits this way causes you to accumulate Heavy Stun buildup. You cannot recover Runic Ward while this Skill is active.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFistOfKalguu.name: Fist Of Kalguur
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFistOfKalguu.description: Supports Slams you use yourself, allowing them to spend large amounts of Runic Ward to become Runically Boosted. Runically Boosted Slams are Empowered with extra Physical damage and create a rune the first time they hit an enemy. The rune erupts in an Aftershock after a duration. Cannot support Channelling Skills.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemFistOfKalguu.tags: Attack, AoE, Melee, Slam, Trigger, Physical, Duration

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVoltaicBarri.name: Voltaic Barrier
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemVoltaicBarri.description: Spend Runic Ward to raise a pair of electrified pylons in front of you which project a wall of electricity between them, damaging and Electrocuting enemies caught between them. Projectiles you fire through the wall become energised, and discharge that energy on Hit as Chaining Lightning beams.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHealingRunes.name: Healing Runes
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemHealingRunes.description: Supports Persistent Buff Skills, causing you to lose Runic Ward and heal nearby allies based on the Ward lost. Healing done is split between allies who are not on full Life.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOlrothsConvi.name: Olroth's Conviction
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOlrothsConvi.description: Supports skills that can Empower a specific number of other skills, causing them to apply to more skill uses.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExplosiveTra.name: Explosive Transmutation
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExplosiveTra.description: While active, picking up Remnants Triggers a deadly explosion, dealing damage at the location of the Remnant based on the type of Remnant picked up.
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemExplosiveTra.tags: Spell, Persistent, AoE, Trigger, Physical, Lightning, Cold, Fire, Chaos

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRainOfBlades.name: Rain of Blades
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemRainOfBlades.description: Pour your Runic Ward into conjuring blades. For the duration of the Buff, these blades fall on enemies Hit by your Projectile Attacks.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOlrothsHubri.name: Olroth's Hubris
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemOlrothsHubri.description: Supports Attacks you use or Trigger yourself, causing them to cost Runic Ward to use but deal additional Physical and Cold damage based on their Runic Ward cost, in addition to causing Physical damage to Contribute to Freeze buildup. Cannot Support Channelling Skills, Sustained Skills, or Skills without a cost.

Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSmashToSmith.name: Smash to Smithereens
Metadata/Items/Gems/SkillGemSmashToSmith.description: Blows strong enough to Heavy Stun an enemy reverberate in an area around the enemy and heavily Break Armour.

AncestralCryShockwavePlayer.name: Volcanic Steps
AncestralCryShockwavePlayer.description: Slam the ground around you, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

AncestralCryProjectilePlayer.name: Volcanic Eruption
AncestralCryProjectilePlayer.description: Fire molten Projectiles from the struck enemy, which will land nearby dealing Attack damage in an area.

CrossbowRequiemPlayer.name: Requiem
CrossbowRequiemPlayer.description: Unleashes a torrent of anguish that bombard the target area, dealing damage in an area on impact. Does not use Ammunition and can be fired freely until the Requiem ends.

InfernalCryCorpseExplosionPlayer.name: Combust
InfernalCryCorpseExplosionPlayer.description: The enemy's Corpse violently explodes, dealing Fire damage in an area around it.

ArmourPiercingBoltsPlayer.name: Armour Piercing Rounds
ArmourPiercingBoltsPlayer.description: Rapidly fire bolts that Break enemy Armour. Can fire a limited number of bolts before needing to reload.

ExplosiveShotPlayer.name: Explosive Shot
ExplosiveShotPlayer.description: Fire a flaming bolt that explodes on impact. The explosion will cause any Grenades in its area of effect to also explode.

FragmentationRoundsPlayer.name: Fragmentation Rounds
FragmentationRoundsPlayer.description: Fire Piercing bolts that fragment in flight. Bolts that hit a Frozen enemy Consume the Freeze and cause an explosion of ice shards. These fragments can Merge.

GalvanicShardsPlayer.name: Galvanic Shards
GalvanicShardsPlayer.description: Rapidly fire charged bolts that fragment in flight, releasing Chaining Lightning beams when they Hit enemies. Can fire a limited number of bursts before needing to reload. These fragments can Merge.

GlacialBoltPlayer.name: Glacial Bolt
GlacialBoltPlayer.description: Fire an icy bolt that creates two walls of Ice Crystals at the end of its flight.

HailstormRoundsPlayer.name: Hailstorm Rounds
HailstormRoundsPlayer.description: Fire all loaded bolts into the sky, causing them to rain down over the target area, starting at the centre and spreading outward.

HighVelocityRoundsPlayer.name: High Velocity Rounds
HighVelocityRoundsPlayer.description: Fire a powerful Piercing bolt that applies Riven Armour to enemies with Fully Broken Armour, causing any Hits against those enemies to deal extra damage.

IceShardsPlayer.name: Ice Shards
IceShardsPlayer.description: Rapidly fire icy bolts at the ground, leaving a shard of ice at the impact location that arms after a duration. After arming, the ice shards explode when enemies step on them, dealing more damage the longer they have been armed, up to a maximum. Can fire a limited number of bolts before needing to reload.

IncendiaryShotPlayer.name: Incendiary Shot
IncendiaryShotPlayer.description: Fire flaming bolts that fragment in flight, damaging and Igniting enemies on hit, and in a small cone behind their final target. These fragments can Merge.

PermafrostBoltsPlayer.name: Permafrost Bolts
PermafrostBoltsPlayer.description: Fire icy bolts that  fragment in flight, damaging enemies on hit and in a small cone behind their final target. The icy coating on the bolts makes them extremely potent at Freezing enemies. These fragments can Merge.

PlasmaBlastPlayer.name: Plasma Blast
PlasmaBlastPlayer.description: Channel to charge an unstable bolt. The bolt deals devastating damage and explodes on hitting terrain, but cannot be fired at all unless fully charged. Additional Projectiles are fired in a spread, unlike other Crossbow Skills.

RapidShotPlayer.name: Rapid Shot
RapidShotPlayer.description: Fire a stream of heated bolts. Heat builds up on your Crossbow as you fire, and reaching maximum heat will prevent you from firing these bolts for a short time. However, other Skills can Consume Heat for extra benefits.

ShockburstRoundsPlayer.name: Shockburst Rounds
ShockburstRoundsPlayer.description: Rapidly fire charged bolts which release damaging pulses upon Hitting an enemy affected by a Lightning Ailment. Can fire a limited number of bolts before needing to reload.

SiegeCascadePlayer.name: Siege Cascade
SiegeCascadePlayer.description: Aim skyward and fires an enemy-seeking payload which drops a bolt near every enemy in the target area. These bolts lodge in the ground and explode after a short delay.

StormblastBoltsPlayer.name: Stormblast Bolts
StormblastBoltsPlayer.description: Aims skyward and fires charged bolts that land around the target location, dealing damage and lodging in the ground for a duration. Detonator Skills will cause these bolts to explode. Can fire a limited number of bolts before needing to reload.

WolfPounceMarkPlayer.name: Predator's Mark
WolfPounceMarkPlayer.description: Mark a target, causing it to take increased damage based on how many of the target's enemies are near to it. If the target dies, the Mark will Activate to Trigger the Summon Wolf skill and Consume the Mark.

WolfPounceSummonWolfPlayer.name: Summon Wolf
WolfPounceSummonWolfPlayer.description: This skill is Triggered when Predator's Mark Activates to Summon a Wolf Minion that follows you as long as it lives.

BloodhoundsMarkExplosionPlayer.name: Blood Explosion
BloodhoundsMarkExplosionPlayer.description: A violent explosion of blood that deals Physical Attack damage which is not based on your Weapon's damage.

TriggeredTrailOfCaltropsPlayer.name: Caltrops
TriggeredTrailOfCaltropsPlayer.description: Maims and deals Attack area damage when triggered by an Enemy. Caltrops are destroyed when triggered, and a maximum of 20 Caltrops can be active at once.

BlinkPlayer.name: Blink
BlinkPlayer.description: While active, replaces your dodge roll with a short-cooldown Spell that allows you to tunnel through space, instantly reappearing a medium distance away.

DarkEffigyProjectilePlayer.name: Vile Effusion
DarkEffigyProjectilePlayer.description: Fire a Projectile at every nearby enemy that is afflicted by a Chaos damage over time Debuff. Fires multiple Projectiles at enemies afflicted by multiple Debuffs, but Projectile count cannot be otherwise modified.

GrimFeastResummonPlayer.name: Grim Resurrection
GrimFeastResummonPlayer.description: Consume stored Minion Life to Revive your Minions. Revives as many Minions as possible with total maximum Life equal to or less than the Life stored by Grim Feast, prioritising those with higher maximum Life.

TriggeredHisWinnowingFlamePillarPlayer.name: Grisly Pyre
TriggeredHisWinnowingFlamePillarPlayer.description: Deal Fire Damage in an Area based on a percentage of the expected Damage of the Consumed Ignite.

TriggeredBattershoutExplosionPlayer.name: Battershout
TriggeredBattershoutExplosionPlayer.description: Deal Physical Area Damage based off of the Broken Armour of the target which this explosion was Triggered from.

TriggeredBrambleslamPlayer.name: Brambles
TriggeredBrambleslamPlayer.description: Creates Hazardous Brambles on the ground that activate after a duration. Enemies which come in contact with these thorns take damage and are Maimed. A maximum of 20 Brambles are allowed at one time.

TriggeredCorruptingCryPlayer.name: Corrupted Cry
TriggeredCorruptingCryPlayer.description: Covers the target in Corrupted Blood which damages them.

TriggeredCorruptingCryTwoPlayer.name: Corrupted Cry
TriggeredCorruptingCryTwoPlayer.description: Covers the target in Corrupted Blood which damages them.

TriggeredCraterPlayer.name: Crater
TriggeredCraterPlayer.description: Creates multiple Fissures when landing with Supported Skill.

TriggeredDeadlyResolvePlayer.name: Deadly Resolve
TriggeredDeadlyResolvePlayer.description: Creates a deadly slash towards the target, dealing Attack damage which is not based on your Weapon.

TriggeredFanTheFlamesPlayer.name: Fan the Flames
TriggeredFanTheFlamesPlayer.description: Causes a fiery explosion in a cone behind the target, dealing Attack damage which is not based on your Weapon

TriggeredFanTheFlamesPlayerTwo.name: Fan the Flames
TriggeredFanTheFlamesPlayerTwo.description: Causes a fiery explosion in a cone behind the target, dealing Attack damage which is not based on your Weapon

TriggeredFlamePillarPlayer.name: Flame Pillar
TriggeredFlamePillarPlayer.description: Deal Fire Damage in an Area based on a percentage of the expected Damage of the Consumed Ignite.

TriggeredHaemocrystalsPlayer.name: Haemocrystals
TriggeredHaemocrystalsPlayer.description: Deal Physical Damage in an Area based on a percentage of the expected Damage of the Consumed Bleeding.

TriggeredCorruptingCryThreePlayer.name: Twisted Pact
TriggeredCorruptingCryThreePlayer.description: Covers the target in large quantities of Corrupted Blood which severely damages them.

TriggeredQuillburstPlayer.name: Quill Burst
TriggeredQuillburstPlayer.description: Deal your Thorns Damage in an Area. Cannot Hit the target this was Triggered from.

TriggeredSkitteringStonePlayer.name: Skittering Stone
TriggeredSkitteringStonePlayer.description: Creates Skittering Stone Minions from shattered objects created by Supported Skill.

TriggeredSkitteringStonePlayerTwo.name: Skittering Stone
TriggeredSkitteringStonePlayerTwo.description: Creates Skittering Stone Minions from shattered objects created by Supported Skill.

TriggeredSplinterExplosionHardyTotems.name: Tawhoa's Vengeance
TriggeredSplinterExplosionHardyTotems.description: Deals Physical Damage in an area, based on Totem Life.

TriggeredVolcanicEruptionPlayer.name: Volcanic Eruption
TriggeredVolcanicEruptionPlayer.description: Fire molten Projectiles from the struck target, which will land nearby dealing Attack damage in an area.

PlagueBurstPlayer.name: Plague Burst
PlagueBurstPlayer.description: Triggered when an enemy Poisoned by a supported skill dies, dealing Physical damage around them based on the built-up Plague.

TriggeredCaltropsPlayer.name: Caltrops
TriggeredCaltropsPlayer.description: Maims and deals Attack area damage when triggered by an Enemy. Caltrops are destroyed when triggered, and a maximum of 20 Caltrops can be active at once.

TriggeredSupportFrozenSpiteIceFragmentPl.name: Ice Fragments
TriggeredSupportFrozenSpiteIceFragmentPl.description: Explodes to deal Cold Damage in an area after a short delay, based on the life of the slain frozen Enemy.

TriggeredPoisonSporesPustule.name: Poison Spores
TriggeredPoisonSporesPustule.description: Attach a Toxic Pustule to the enemy, which Detonates after a delay, dealing Attack damage. They can also be Poisoned, causing them to Detonate faster and more violently.

TriggeredExplosiveGrowthPlayerTwo.name: Accelerated Growth
TriggeredExplosiveGrowthPlayerTwo.description: Spawn a verdant flower that grows and explodes.

TriggeredExplosiveGrowthPlayer.name: Accelerated Growth
TriggeredExplosiveGrowthPlayer.description: Spawn a verdant flower that grows and explodes.

TriggeredBoneShrapnelPlayer.name: Bone Shrapnel Explosion
TriggeredBoneShrapnelPlayer.description: Deal Physical Area Damage based off of the maximum Life of the Pinned target slain.

TriggeredBurningRunesPlayer.name: Burning Inscription
TriggeredBurningRunesPlayer.description: Create Ignited Ground Igniting Enemies based on a percentage of your Maximum Mana.

TriggeredCatalysingDischargePlayer.name: Catalysing Discharge
TriggeredCatalysingDischargePlayer.description: Triggered when supported skill is boosted by an Elemental Ground Surface to deal damage of the matching Element.

TriggeredDeadlyCurrentPlayer.name: Coursing Current
TriggeredDeadlyCurrentPlayer.description: Sends a Chaining Lightning Projectile from the Shocked enemy towards a nearby Drenched enemy, dealing Spell damage.

TriggeredCreepingChillPlayer.name: Creeping Chill
TriggeredCreepingChillPlayer.description: Creates spreading Chilled Ground around Ice Crystals created by Supported Skills.

TriggeredDecayingHexPlayer.name: Profane Decay
TriggeredDecayingHexPlayer.description: Inflicts Decay on the target, dealing Chaos Damage over time.

ChaosFrogExplosionPlayer.name: Dark Consequences
ChaosFrogExplosionPlayer.description: Explodes a Witchtoad to deal spell damage in an area.

TriggeredCurseZoneHazardExplosionPlayer.name: Doedre's Dark Design
TriggeredCurseZoneHazardExplosionPlayer.description: Explodes and deals Chaos Damage when an Enemy enters the area, applying the supported Curse on Hit.

TriggeredShockingRiftPlayer.name: Electromagnetism
TriggeredShockingRiftPlayer.description: Pull enemies in and pulse Lightning damage, Hindering enemies Hit. Each pulse increases in damage, with the final pulse dealing additional damage.

TriggeredElementalDischargePlayer.name: Elemental Discharge
TriggeredElementalDischargePlayer.description: Triggered when supported skill Consumes Ignite, Shock, or Freeze, to deal damage of Types matching the Consumed Ailments.

DoomBlastPlayer.name: Doom Blast
DoomBlastPlayer.description: Deal Chaos damage in an area around the previously Cursed enemy.

TriggeredStaticShocksPlayer.name: Static Shocks
TriggeredStaticShocksPlayer.description: Attaches a Static Shock to a target that pulses Lightning damage to the attached target and nearby enemies. Targets can have a maximum of one Static Shock attached to them.

TriggeredXibaquasRendingPlayer.name: Fiery Reclamation
TriggeredXibaquasRendingPlayer.description: Deals Fire damage in an area around the exploding Corpse based on its maximum Life.

ApocalypseColdPlayer.name: Hailstorm
ApocalypseColdPlayer.description: Targets an area or an enemy, causing a series of icy hailstones to rain down in an area over a duration.

ApocalypseFirePlayer.name: Meteor
ApocalypseFirePlayer.description: Targets an area or an enemy, calling down a massive meteor to strike an area, dealing Fire damage and contributing to your enemies' extinction.

ApocalypseLightningPlayer.name: Crash Lightning
ApocalypseLightningPlayer.description: Targets an area or an enemy, causing a rapid buildup of pulsing Lightning damage in an area that culminates in a powerful final Lightning strike.

ArchonOfChayulaTornadoPlayer.name: Chayula's Will
ArchonOfChayulaTornadoPlayer.description: Conjure a Chaos tornado that chases down and Slows enemies.

UnloadAmmoPlayer.name: Basic Bolt
UnloadAmmoPlayer.description: Clear your active Bolt and reload any ammunition.

CurseOfRepulsionShockwavePlayer.name: Repulsion Wave
CurseOfRepulsionShockwavePlayer.description: Deals Physical Attack damage in an area around the Cursed target that is not based on your Weapon's damage. Other targets are Knocked back and take more Stun buildup based on the Fragility they have.

NightfallEmbraceTheFallPlayer.name: Embrace The Fall
NightfallEmbraceTheFallPlayer.description: Teleport to your thrown Shield, appearing in the air and Slamming it into the ground to deal damage in an area. Destroying an Ice Crystal with this skill skips the cooldown of Soaring Midnight.

TemperWeaponCombustionPlayer.name: Combust
TemperWeaponCombustionPlayer.description: Explode, dealing Fire damage in an area.

TheStarsAnswerCometPlayer.name: Starfall
TheStarsAnswerCometPlayer.description: A star falls at a targeted location, dealing area damage on impact. Larger stars leave Chilled Ground for a short duration.

TriggeredFracturedSelfPlayer.name: Fragment Self
TriggeredFracturedSelfPlayer.description: Creates a Fractured Mimic of yourself, suspended in time at the point of casting the Triggering Spell. If you reach the Limit of Fractured Mimics, they will all finish casting their Spells and disappear.

TriggeredManifestRunePlayer.name: Manifest Rune
TriggeredManifestRunePlayer.description: Summon a short-lived Verisium Manifestation that launches Projectile Attacks at enemies.
